items.title: Google表外擔保暴增至438億美元！豪賭AI、換取TPU銷售動能
items.title_en: Google’s Off‑Balance‑Sheet Guarantees Surge to $43.8 B! Betting Big on AI to Boost TPU Sales
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）軍備競賽白熱化之際，Google 母公司 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 正悄悄向華爾街的金融工程借力，用一套過去鮮少出現在科技巨頭身上的手法，即透過大規模表外擔保，來為自研 AI 晶片鋪路。
根據 Alphabet 最新揭露的財報資訊，該公司為資料中心租戶提供的潛在違約擔保，其「名目金額」已從去年九月底的 65 億美元，一口氣暴增近六倍，來到 438 億美元。
這也代表，一旦擔保對象出現財務問題，Google 最壞情況下可能需要承擔的支付責任，已達到數百億美元等級。

用擔保換市占：TPU 對抗輝達的另一條路

根據《The Information》報導，這波擔保潮的背後，是 Google 推廣自家張量處理器（TPU）的野心。
相較於輝達 (NVDA-US) 的 AI 晶片，TPU 若要打入更多資料中心與客戶（例如 Anthropic），往往需要開發商能以較低成本取得融資。
而 Google 提供的財務擔保，正好能替這些資料中心開發商增加信用背書，讓他們更容易借到便宜的錢、加快機房興建速度。
換言之，Google 正用自己的資產負債表當作籌碼，以換取 TPU 在市場上的擴張空間。
知情人士向媒體透露，Google 內部評估後認為，未來 TPU 銷售所帶來的營收，將遠遠超過這些擔保可能造成的財務負擔，高層對這筆帳相當有信心。
目前，Google 已針對約十個資料中心專案、合計約 2.4 吉瓦的電力容量提供了擔保，不過由於相關工程都還沒完工，這些擔保實際上尚未啟動。
值得留意的是，這類交易多半有固定的三角結構：雲端新創公司 Fluidstack 負責承租與規劃資料中心，並在裡面裝設 TPU，再將運算力轉租給 Anthropic 等終端使用者。
而 Hut 8 (HUT-US) 、TeraWulf (WULF-US) 這類原本從事加密貨幣挖礦、如今轉型投入 AI 基礎設施的業者，則常是資料中心的實際營運方。

帳面數字看似驚人 實際風險受控？

儘管 438 億美元的名目擔保金額十分嚇人，但真正記錄在 Alphabet 資產負債表上的公允價值，其實只有 8.15 億美元。
這是因為「名目價值」代表的是最極端情境下的最大可能損失，而公允價值才是 Google 根據違約機率、違約時間點與可回收金額等假設，估算出的實際預期支出。
信評機構 CreditSights 技術研究主管 Jordan Chalfin 指出，外界不需要對這個名目數字過度緊張，因為有多重機制能緩解風險。
舉例來說，若租戶違約，Google 通常有權接手底層的租約，自行使用或轉租給其他客戶，等於變相取得了稀缺的運算容量；再加上許多租約長達十五年，潛在的風險敞口會隨時間逐步遞減。
Fitch Ratings 信用分析師 Anubhav Arora 則坦言，評等機構之所以願意給這些資料中心專案投資等級評等，「高度仰賴 Google 提供的擔保」作為信用支撐。
他預期這股趨勢短期內不會停歇，畢竟 Google 過去十二個月的營運現金流超過 1850 億美元，融資實力仍相當雄厚。

資產負債表大變身：從「零負債」神話到近千億美元舉債

Alphabet 長年給外界的印象，是現金水位極高、幾乎不需要靠負債擴張的穩健企業。然而，這樣的形象正快速瓦解。
截至六月底，Alphabet 的債務規模已從一年前的 236 億美元，暴增至 980 億美元；公司並在二十多年來首次發行新股籌資。上季財報更顯示，Alphabet 作為上市公司，史上首度出現自由現金流為負的季度。
除了已生效的 438 億美元擔保外，Alphabet 另外還簽下總額 852 億美元、尚未正式啟動的表外資料中心租賃合約；為協助合作夥伴取得電力與能源設備，又額外提供了 76 億美元的後備擔保，並已承諾在條款拍板後，再追加 241 億美元的未來擔保額度。
分析人士指出，這股靠表外工具支撐 AI 建設的風潮並非 Google 獨有。Meta(META-US) 透過在路易斯安那州、德州成立少數股權合資企業，把資料中心建設成本移出自家資產負債表。
此外，甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 同樣仰賴類似的表外安排來支應擴張野心。AI 基礎設施的燒錢速度，正迫使科技巨頭們一齊向華爾街的融資手法靠攏。

提供擔保也要分一杯羹：認股權證鎖住上檔獲利

有趣的是，Google 在承擔下檔風險的同時，也沒忘記為自己爭取上檔利益。
在部分交易中，Google 會以提供擔保為條件，向資料中心開發商換取股權認股權證。換言之，若這些公司股價表現亮眼，Google 也能跟著受惠。
例如，在紐約州巴克為 Fluidstack 興建資料中心的 TeraWulf，Google 握有的認股權證相當於該公司 14% 股權；在與 Cipher Digital 的合作案中，Google 也取得價值相當於 5.4% 股權的認股權證。
一旦 Google 選擇提前終止擔保，雖然可能得向債券持有人支付一大筆一次性費用，但這筆錢實質上會轉化為對該專案的所有權權益。
不過並非所有交易都如此對等。以 Hut 8 的合作案為例，Fitch Ratings 指出，若 Fluidstack 違約，Google 必須概括承受長達十五年租期的全部付款義務，而且一旦工程出現重大延誤，雙方都無法片面解除合約。
更特別的是，Google 在這筆交易中並未取得任何認股權證。Hut 8 執行長 Asher Genoot 在財報電話會議上透露，這筆資料中心租約總價值達 70 億美元，另加約 20 億美元的電力與財產稅保險等費用。
知情人士表示，這筆交易條件特殊，外界普遍認為未來不太可能複製。
paras_en: As the AI arms race heats up, Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Google’s parent, is quietly tapping Wall Street’s financial engineering, using a technique rarely seen at tech giants: massive off‑balance‑sheet guarantees to pave the way for its own AI chips.

According to Alphabet’s latest disclosed financials, the potential default guarantees it provides to data‑center tenants have a "nominal amount" that jumped from $6.5 billion at the end of September last year to nearly six times that, reaching $43.8 billion.
That means, if a guaranteed party runs into financial trouble, Google could be on the hook for payments in the hundreds of billions of dollars in a worst‑case scenario.
Using Guarantees to Gain Market Share: TPU’s Alternative Path Against Nvidia
The wave of guarantees, reported by The Information, is driven by Google’s ambition to push its own Tensor Processing Units (TPUs).
Compared with Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) AI chips, TPUs need developers to obtain financing at lower cost in order to win more data‑centers and customers such as Anthropic.
Google’s financial guarantees give those data‑center developers a credit endorsement, making it easier for them to borrow cheap money and speed up facility construction.
In other words, Google is using its balance sheet as a bargaining chip to expand TPU market reach.

Insiders told the media that internal assessments show future TPU‑related revenue will far outweigh any financial burden from the guarantees, and senior management is very confident about the accounting line.

So far Google has provided guarantees for about ten data‑center projects covering roughly 2.4 GW of power capacity, but because the projects are not yet completed, the guarantees have not been triggered.

These deals typically follow a triangular structure: the cloud‑startup Fluidstack leases and plans the data center, installs TPUs inside, and then sub‑leases compute capacity to end users such as Anthropic.
Companies that originally mined cryptocurrency, such as Hut 8 (HUT-US) and TeraWulf (WULF-US), have pivoted to AI infrastructure and often act as the actual operators of the data centers.
The headline figure of $43.8 billion looks alarming, but the fair‑value amount recorded on Alphabet’s balance sheet is only $815 million.

The "nominal value" reflects the maximum possible loss in an extreme scenario, whereas fair value is the expected outflow Google estimates based on default probability, timing and recoverable amounts.
Credit‑rating firm CreditSights’ technical research head Jordan Chalfin says the market need not overreact to the nominal number because multiple mechanisms mitigate risk.

For example, if a tenant defaults, Google usually has the right to take over the underlying lease, use the space itself or re‑lease it to another customer, effectively acquiring scarce compute capacity; many leases run up to fifteen years, so exposure diminishes over time.

Fitch Ratings analyst Anubhav Arora notes that rating agencies are willing to give these data‑center projects investment‑grade ratings largely because of the “highly relied‑upon” guarantees from Google.
He expects the trend to continue in the short term, given Alphabet’s operating cash flow of over $185 billion in the past twelve months, which shows strong financing capacity.
Balance‑Sheet Transformation: From a "Zero‑Debt" Myth to Nearly $100 Billion of Borrowing
Alphabet has long cultivated an image of a cash‑rich, virtually debt‑free, ultra‑stable company, but that perception is rapidly eroding.

As of the end of June, Alphabet’s debt rose from $23.6 billion a year ago to $98 billion, and the company issued new equity for the first time in more than two decades. Its most recent quarterly report even showed a negative free‑cash‑flow quarter for the first time in history.

In addition to the $43.8 billion of guarantees already in effect, Alphabet has signed off‑balance‑sheet data‑center lease contracts totaling $85.2 billion that have not yet been activated; it also provided a $7.6 billion backup guarantee to help partners secure power and equipment, and has pledged an additional $24.1 billion of future guarantees once the terms are finalized.

Analysts point out that this wave of off‑balance‑sheet tools to fund AI builds is not unique to Google. Meta (META-US) has created minority‑equity joint ventures in Louisiana and Texas to move data‑center construction costs off its own balance sheet.

Oracle (ORCL-US) similarly relies on comparable off‑balance‑sheet arrangements to fund its expansion ambitions. The cash‑burn rate of AI infrastructure is pushing the tech giants toward Wall Street‑style financing.
Guarantees Also Earn a Slice of the Upside: Warrants Lock In Potential Gains
Interestingly, while Google assumes downside risk, it also secures upside upside by extracting equity‑linked warrants in some transactions.
In certain deals, Google provides guarantees in exchange for stock warrants from the data‑center developers. If those companies’ shares perform well, Google benefits as well.

For example, in the TeraWulf data‑center that Fluidstack is building in Buck, New York, Google holds warrants equivalent to 14 % of the company’s equity; in its partnership with Cipher Digital, Google obtained warrants representing roughly 5.4 % of the equity.
If Google chooses to terminate a guarantee early, it may have to pay a large one‑time fee to bondholders, but that payment effectively converts into an ownership stake in the project.

However, not all transactions are structured that way. In the Hut 8 deal, Fitch Ratings notes that if Fluidstack defaults, Google would have to assume the full payment obligations for the entire fifteen‑year lease, and any major construction delay would prevent either party from unilaterally walking away.

Moreover, Google did not receive any warrants in that particular transaction. Hut 8 CEO Asher Genoot told the earnings call that the data‑center lease is valued at $7 billion, plus roughly $2 billion in power, property‑tax and insurance costs.
Insiders say the terms of that deal are unique and unlikely to be replicated elsewhere.

items.title: 手機漲價潮蔓延 今年來小米三度漲價
items.title_en: Smartphone Price Hike Spreads: Xiaomi Raises Prices for the Third Time This Year
paras: 近日小米 (01810-HK) 17 系列漲價人民幣（下同）400 元至 500 元，REDMI K90、Turbo 5 全系上調 300 元，9 款在售主力機型同步執行新價。
這已是小米今年來第三輪調價。4 月 11 日先動 REDMI K90 Pro Max 與 Turbo 5，年中再度跟進，8 月把旗艦小米 17 系列也拉進名單。
據《21 世紀經濟報導》4 日（周二）報導，放到行業裡看，這並非孤例：3 月中旬 OPPO、vivo 已先行調價，榮耀以「煥新版」變相提價，三星 Galaxy S26 國行版抬高門檻，導火索是記憶體晶片漲價。
矛盾也同樣清晰：終端廠商毛利承壓，出貨收縮，上游記憶體廠商利潤翻倍，分歧最終收斂為兩點——上游新產能何時釋放，以及終端毛利率能否守住兩位數。
小米調價路徑本身是成本壓力的體現。小米集團合夥人、總裁盧偉冰在 3 月 25 日財報業績會上很克制地表示，記憶體從 2025 年第三季起漲，是長周期，很可能會貫穿到 2027 年，「手機漲價或早或晚不可避免，儘量為消費者多扛一段」。
paras_en: Recently, Xiaomi (01810-HK) raised the price of its 17 series by 400 to 500 yuan, while the REDMI K90 and Turbo 5 series were increased by 300 yuan across the board, with nine main models implementing the new prices simultaneously.

This is the third price adjustment made by Xiaomi this year. On April 11, the company first raised the prices of the REDMI K90 Pro Max and Turbo 5, followed by another adjustment in the middle of the year, and now the flagship Xiaomi 17 series has also been included in the price hike.

According to a report by the 21st Century Business Herald on Tuesday, this is not an isolated case in the industry. In mid-March, OPPO and vivo had already raised their prices, while Honor increased prices under the guise of a "new version", and the Samsung Galaxy S26 Chinese edition also saw a price increase, driven by the rising cost of memory chips.

The contradiction is clear: terminal manufacturers are under pressure to maintain their profit margins, with shipments shrinking, while upstream memory manufacturers are seeing their profits double. The disagreement ultimately boils down to two points - when will new upstream production capacity be released, and whether terminal manufacturers can maintain a double-digit profit margin.

Xiaomi's price hike is a reflection of the cost pressure it is facing. At the company's earnings conference on March 25, Xiaomi's partner and president, Lu Weibing, stated that memory prices will rise from the third quarter of 2025, a long-term trend that may continue until 2027, and that "smartphone price hikes are inevitable, sooner or later, and we will try to bear the cost for consumers for as long as possible".

items.title: 美AI股反彈動能本周迎「硬門檻」！華爾街估7月非農就業新增8.5萬人 Kalshi押7萬區間
items.title_en: US AI Stocks Face "Hard Threshold" This Week as Wall Street Expects 850,000 July Non-Farm Payroll Additions
paras: 美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 本週五 (7 日) 將公布 7 月非農就業新增人數，道瓊斯經濟學家一致預期新增 8.5 萬人、失業率 4.3%，《路透社》調查中位數落在 8.3-8.5 萬人，巴克莱等樂觀派看 10 萬，相較於 6 月僅增 5.7 萬、失業率 4.2%，市場實質押注「低成長但未失速」的溫和放緩。
對全球股票多頭、尤其半導體與 AI 算力鏈而言，週五數據是 7 月底暴力反彈後第一道硬門檻。6 月非農就業人數爆冷至僅新增 5.7 萬人後，「升息預期降溫」讓那指與費半指數獲得喘息機會。
最理想情境是新增 7 萬至 10 萬人、失業率穩在 4.2% 至 4.3%、薪資續降的「金髮姑娘」組合，既證明消費與企業獲利未滑向衰退，又不逼聯準會 (Fed) 強化升息路徑，壓低實質利率與折現率，這對長期、估值敏感的 HBM、網通與 AI 應用股屬於利多。
但付費預測市場搶跑華爾街。Kalshi 與 Polymarket 真金白銀押注者認為，7 月新增逾 8 萬人機率僅 47%、超 7 萬人約 60%、達 9 萬人約 41%、破 10 萬人略高於三分之一，不到 6 萬人機率約三分之一。
Kalshi 上月曾押注 6 月超 12.5 萬機率 63%，結果最終 5.7 萬，預測盤同樣看走眼。
不過，若新增破 10 萬人且薪資增幅重新加速，聯準會 9 月升息機率 (當前約 64% 至 68%) 與長債殖利率回彈，30 年期美債曾觸 5.24% 至 5.27%，高估值 AI 股吃不下第二輪利率衝擊。
若低於 6 萬人且失業率彈升、工時萎縮，債市初步上漲後邏輯會切至「獲利衰退」，週期、金融、出口鏈將先受到影響。
油價周一 (3 日) 收跌約 5%、美債殖利率回落帶動標普 500 指數收漲 1.48%、那指漲 2.13%，多頭依賴的正是「油價降＋利率降＋科技獲利韌性」三大利多共振。
專家指出，非農數據不是單一利多，而是把 7 月槓桿強平後的技術修復，升格為新一輪風險偏好上行、或是打回高波動回補的分水嶺。
paras_en: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is set to release the July non-farm payroll additions on Friday, with Wall Street economists unanimously expecting an addition of 850,000 jobs and a 4.3% unemployment rate. A Reuters survey puts the median estimate at 830,000 to 850,000, while Barclays and other optimistic analysts predict 1 million additions, compared to the 570,000 additions in June and a 4.2% unemployment rate. The market is essentially betting on a "soft landing" with moderate growth but no slowdown.

For global stock bulls, particularly those in the semiconductor and AI computing chains, Friday's data will be the first "hard threshold" since the violent rebound at the end of July. After the June non-farm payroll additions came in at a disappointing 570,000, "dovish" expectations of interest rate hikes gave the Nasdaq and the Philly Fed Index a breather.

The ideal scenario would be an addition of 700,000 to 1 million jobs, a stable unemployment rate of 4.2% to 4.3%, and a decline in wages, which would prove that consumption and corporate profits have not yet slid into a recession, while also not forcing the Federal Reserve (Fed) to strengthen its interest rate hike path, thereby lowering the effective interest rate and discount rate. This would be a positive for long-term, value-sensitive stocks in HBM, telecom, and AI applications.

However, paid prediction markets are beating Wall Street to the punch. Kalshi and Polymarket's silver-tongued bettors believe that the probability of adding over 800,000 jobs is only 47%, while exceeding 700,000 jobs is around 60%, reaching 900,000 jobs is approximately 41%, and breaking 1 million jobs is slightly above one-third. The probability of adding less than 600,000 jobs is around one-third.
Kalshi had previously bet on a 63% probability of exceeding 12.5 million jobs in June, but the actual number came in at 570,000, with the prediction market also looking over-optimistic.

However, if the additions exceed 1 million and wages growth accelerates, the Fed's interest rate hike probability in September (currently around 64% to 68%) and the long-term bond yield will rebound, with the 30-year US Treasury yield touching 5.24% to 5.27%, which would be a second-round shock for high-valued AI stocks.

If the additions are below 600,000 and the unemployment rate rises, with hours worked declining, the bond market will initially rally before logic shifts to "profit decline," with cyclicals, financials, and export chains being the first to be affected.

Oil prices fell by around 5% on Monday, with the 10-year Treasury yield decline driving the S&P 500 index up 1.48% and the Nasdaq up 2.13%, with bulls relying on the "oil price down + interest rate down + tech profit resilience" triple bullish synergy.

Experts point out that non-farm payroll data is not a single bullish factor, but rather a technical repair of the July 7th strong flattening, which has been upgraded to a new round of risk-on, or a dividing line for high volatility to rebound.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉健策均熱片比重持續提升 亮燈漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Jenstronics' Profit Margin Continues to Rise, Surging to a New High
paras: 健策 (3653-TW) 受惠 B300 放量，加上 Rubin 出貨，均熱片營收比重持續提升，加上漲價效益，法人預期，健策第二季毛利率與獲利都將季增，激勵健策今 (4) 日亮燈漲停，鎖住 4145 元。
健策今天早盤以 3710 元開低，不過盤中翻紅走高，亮燈漲停鎖住 4145 元，站穩所有均線，排名千金股第 9 名，排隊委買單約 800 張，成交量超過 2000 張。
健策提到，自本季開始，每個月 ASIC 出貨量將超越 GPU，ASIC 產品將逐步放量。健策 6 月營收 26.5 億元，月增 15%，年增 58%，創單月新高紀錄；累計今年上半年營收 126 億元，年增 27%，同步寫歷史同期新高。
GPU 方面，除 B300 與 Rubin 穩定貢獻，法人指出，Rubin Ultra 均熱片已完成初步測試，並預計於明年第二季放量生產，時程較原先預期下半年放量提前。因此法人看好，明年在 Rubin Ultra 帶動下，營收、獲利都將成長。
paras_en: Jenstronics (3653-TW) benefited from the large-scale B300 order, combined with Rubin's shipment, resulting in a continuous increase in the proportion of revenue from uniform heating films. Additionally, the price increase effect is expected to boost Jenstronics' second-quarter gross margin and net profit, prompting the stock to surge to a new high on April 4, closing at NT$41,450.

Jenstronics opened at NT$37,100 in the morning session, but turned red and rose during the session, surging to a new high of NT$41,450 and stabilizing above all moving averages. It ranked 9th among the top stocks and had a queue of buy orders for approximately 800 shares, with a trading volume exceeding 2,000 shares.

Jenstronics mentioned that starting from this quarter, the monthly shipment of ASIC products will exceed that of GPU products, with ASIC products being gradually released in large quantities. In June, Jenstronics' revenue reached NT$2.65 billion, a 15% increase from the previous month and a 58% increase from the same period last year, setting a new single-month record. items.title: 股匯動盪避險需求升溫 台新Richart推6個月2.2%優利定存吸資金
items.title_en: Taiwan New Richart Launches 2.2% 6-Month Fixed Deposit to Attract Capital
paras: 面對近期市場利率變化與股匯市波動，民眾對穩健收益與資金調配的需求升溫。台新銀行旗下數位品牌 Richart 宣布，推出新一波「新資金新台幣優利定存專案」，提供 6 個月年利率 2.2% 優惠，並開放單一用戶可承作多筆定存，以提高資金配置彈性。
據台新銀行觀察，不少投資人於股匯市波動期間，偏好將定存作為儲備金或短期資金的停泊工具。為此，Richart 延續先前的利率方案，擴大資金調配空間，推出 6 個月期定存年利率 2.2%，單筆承作門檻 1 萬元起，上限 200 萬元。
符合新資金條件者，開放單一用戶可承作多筆專案，方便依不同用途進行資金分流，活動即日起至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止 (若額滿將提前截止)。
除了定存方案外，針對首次開立 Richart 數位存款帳戶的新用戶，業者亦推出相關搭配方案。新戶開啟指定優利子帳戶後，可享有 30 萬元額度內 3.5% 的優惠活儲利率；同時於開戶時輸入專屬代碼「2026RT200」並完成登入，可另獲 200 元用戶禮。
隨著各大金融機構持續調整數位帳戶策略，業者試圖透過「高息活儲」與「多筆定存」的組合，吸引有短期資金避險與靈活運用需求的存款族群。台新 Richart 未來也將持續推出便利且具競爭力的數位金融方案，協助用戶更靈活運用每一筆資金，打造更安心、有效率的理財體驗。
paras_en: In response to recent market interest rate fluctuations and currency exchange rate volatility, public demand for stable returns and capital allocation has increased. Taiwan New Bank's digital brand Richart has announced the launch of a new round of 'New Capital New Taiwan Dollar Fixed Deposit Project', offering a 6-month annual interest rate of 2.2% and opening up single users to make multiple deposits to improve capital allocation flexibility.

According to Taiwan New Bank's observation, many investors during the currency exchange rate volatility period prefer to use fixed deposits as a reserve or short-term capital anchorage tool. Therefore, Richart has continued the previous interest rate scheme, expanding the capital allocation space, launching a 6-month fixed deposit with an annual interest rate of 2.2%, with a single deposit threshold of NT$100,000 and a maximum of NT$2 million.

Eligible new capital users are allowed to make multiple projects for a single user, making it convenient to allocate funds for different purposes, and the activity will start from today to September 30, 2026 (if full, it will be closed in advance).

In addition to the fixed deposit scheme, the company has also launched a related scheme for new users who open a Richart digital savings account for the first time. New users who open a specified high-interest savings account can enjoy a 3.5% interest rate for up to NT$300,000; at the same time, by inputting the exclusive code '2026RT200' and completing the login at the time of opening the account, they can also receive NT$200 in user gifts.

As major financial institutions continue to adjust their digital account strategies, companies are trying to attract short-term capital risk avoidance and flexible use demand through 'high-interest savings' and 'multiple fixed deposits' combinations. Taiwan New Richart will also continue to launch convenient and competitive digital financial schemes in the future to help users more flexibly use each piece of capital and create a more secure and efficient financial experience.

items.title: 俄羅斯警告愛爾蘭：這是海盜行為！後果很嚴重
items.title_en: Russia Warns Ireland: This is Piracy! Consequences are Severe
paras: 據《塔斯社》3 日（周一）報導，俄羅斯駐愛爾蘭大使尤里 · 菲拉托夫（Yury Filatov）表示，俄方已向愛爾蘭發出警告，如果都柏林以涉嫌違反對俄制裁為由，對商船採取「海盜行徑」， 將引發嚴重後果。
愛爾蘭近期通過的法律規定，愛爾蘭軍隊可以「打擊違反對俄制裁行為」為由登船檢查。
據英國《衛報》3 日報導，近幾周愛爾蘭官員發現，越來越多俄羅斯「影子艦隊」船隻正穿行北大西洋愛爾蘭附近水域，以繞開管控升級的英國和法國水域。
長期以來，西方國家指控俄羅斯利用油輪等商用船隻逃避西方制裁，將這些商用船隻稱為「影子艦隊」。除俄羅斯外，委內瑞拉、伊朗也被指控利用此類船隊出口石油。
歐盟已通過一批對俄制裁方案，包括對俄羅斯「影子艦隊」船隻實施制裁，禁止其停靠歐盟港口，並停止提供相關海事服務。
義大利國防部 8 月 2 日稱，在地中海執行歐盟長期軍事行動的義大利海軍，當天攔截一艘受制裁的俄羅斯「影子艦隊」油輪。這是歐盟近兩周來第二次此類攔查行動。
英國和法國均已表示，將阻截任何途經領海、與俄羅斯受制裁「影子艦隊」有關的船隻。英國政府於今年 3 月宣布，已授權軍方檢查「影子艦隊」船隻。
英國前首相施凱爾 6 月 14 日證實，武裝部隊當天凌晨在英吉利海峽攔截一艘俄羅斯「影子艦隊」船隻。
英國國防部則稱，在一項六小時行動中，英國皇家海軍陸戰隊突擊隊員與國家打擊犯罪局受過專門訓練的執法人員，登上了這艘受制裁油輪，這是英方首次主導此類行動。
paras_en: Russia's Ambassador to Ireland, Yury Filatov, stated that Russia has issued a warning to Ireland, saying that if Dublin takes 'pirate-like' measures against commercial ships suspected of violating sanctions against Russia, it will have severe consequences.
Ireland recently passed a law allowing its military to board and inspect ships for violating sanctions against Russia.

According to a report by The Guardian, Irish officials have discovered that an increasing number of Russian 'shadow fleet' ships are sailing through the North Atlantic near Ireland, avoiding the upgraded controls of the UK and France.

Western countries have long accused Russia of using oil tankers and other commercial ships to evade sanctions, referring to these ships as the 'shadow fleet'. Venezuela and Iran have also been accused of using similar ship fleets to export oil.
The EU has implemented a series of sanctions against Russia, including a ban on Russian 'shadow fleet' ships docking at EU ports and providing related maritime services.

The Italian Ministry of Defense reported on August 2 that the Italian Navy, which is executing a long-term EU military operation in the Mediterranean, intercepted a Russian 'shadow fleet' oil tanker that was subject to sanctions. This was the second such interception by the EU in the past two weeks.

The UK and France have both stated that they will intercept any ships passing through their territorial waters that are related to Russia's sanctioned 'shadow fleet'. The UK government announced in March that it had authorized the military to inspect 'shadow fleet' ships.
Former UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak confirmed on June 14 that British forces had intercepted a Russian 'shadow fleet' ship in the English Channel.

The UK Ministry of Defense stated that in a six-hour operation, British Royal Marines and specially trained law enforcement officers from the National Crime Agency boarded the sanctioned oil tanker, marking the first time the UK has led such an operation.

items.title: 蘋果20週年大改版！iPhone 20傳採玻璃超薄機身 散熱再升級
items.title_en: Apple 20th Anniversary iPhone 20 Rumored to Feature Glass Body and Improved Cooling
paras: 蘋果傳出計畫在 2027 年底推出 iPhone 問世 20 週年紀念機型，市場暫稱「iPhone 20」。最新消息指出，這款新機可能大量採用玻璃材質，並借鑑 iPhone Air 的超薄設計，同時擴大機身內部的散熱空間，以兼顧輕薄外型與效能表現。
微博爆料帳號「定焦數碼」近日表示，iPhone 20 的機身將以玻璃為主要材料，中框設計則可能接近 iPhone Air，整體厚度也有望維持在相近水準。
過去相關傳聞曾指出，蘋果可能為這款紀念機導入大面積曲面玻璃及固態按鍵，進一步減少傳統機械結構，打造更一體化的外觀。
這並非「定焦數碼」首次將 iPhone 20 與 iPhone Air 相提並論。該帳號 7 月便曾透露，蘋果準備讓週年紀念機型「回歸玻璃」，部分零組件可能沿用第一代 iPhone Air 採用的加工方式。
除了外觀變化，iPhone 20 的散熱能力也可能升級。

目前尚無法確定 iPhone 20 是否會直接採用均熱板散熱。
iPhone 17 Pro 系列已導入均熱板技術，可將 A19 Pro 晶片產生的熱量快速分散至機身其他區域；定位更輕薄的 iPhone Air 則未採用相同方案。
考量超薄機身通常更難處理熱量，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 若要進一步提升紀念機型的性能，導入均熱板具有一定合理性。
同一爆料來源先前也曾宣稱，折疊式 iPhone 將配置多組均熱板。不過，所謂散熱板面積增加，也可能只是代表蘋果擴大傳統導熱材料，而非確定採用均熱板。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週一 (3 日) 下滑約 1.8%，收在 303.42 美元，連續第四個交易日收黑，由於 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 市值超越蘋果，使蘋果跌至全美市值第三大企業。

According to the latest rumors, this new device may feature a glass body and adopt the ultra-thin design of the iPhone Air, while also expanding the internal cooling space to balance the lightweight exterior and performance.

A Weibo account called '定焦數碼' (Ding Jiao Shu Mu) recently claimed that the iPhone 20's body will be made of glass, with a middle frame design similar to the iPhone Air, and a thickness that may be similar to the Air.

Previous rumors suggested that Apple might introduce large-area curved glass and solid-state buttons for this commemorative model, further reducing traditional mechanical structures and creating a more integrated appearance.

This is not the first time '定焦數碼' has compared the iPhone 20 to the iPhone Air. The account revealed in July that Apple plans to let the anniversary model 'return to glass,' with some components possibly using the same processing method as the first-generation iPhone Air.
In addition to the exterior changes, the iPhone 20's cooling capabilities may also be upgraded.

'定焦數碼' claims that the new device's heat sink will be expanded by about '1 inch,' implying that Apple may equip this ultra-thin model with a larger heat-dissipation structure to improve stability during long periods of high-load work.
It is currently unclear whether the iPhone 20 will directly adopt the uniform heat plate cooling system.

The iPhone 17 Pro series has already introduced uniform heat plate technology, which quickly disperses heat generated by the A19 Pro chip to other areas of the device; in contrast, the thinner iPhone Air does not use the same scheme.

Considering that ultra-thin devices often have difficulty handling heat, Apple (AAPL-US) may have a rational reason to introduce uniform heat plates to further improve the performance of the commemorative model.

The same leak source previously claimed that the foldable iPhone would be equipped with multiple uniform heat plates. However, the increased heat sink area may simply represent Apple expanding traditional heat-dissipation materials rather than adopting uniform heat plates.

items.title: 股匯動盪避險需求升溫 台新Richart推6個月2.2%優利定存吸資金
items.title_en: Taiwan New Richart Launches 2.2% 6-Month Fixed Deposit to Attract Capital
paras: 面對近期市場利率變化與股匯市波動，民眾對穩健收益與資金調配的需求升溫。台新銀行旗下數位品牌 Richart 宣布，推出新一波「新資金新台幣優利定存專案」，提供 6 個月年利率 2.2% 優惠，並開放單一用戶可承作多筆定存，以提高資金配置彈性。
據台新銀行觀察，不少投資人於股匯市波動期間，偏好將定存作為儲備金或短期資金的停泊工具。為此，Richart 延續先前的利率方案，擴大資金調配空間，推出 6 個月期定存年利率 2.2%，單筆承作門檻 1 萬元起，上限 200 萬元。
符合新資金條件者，開放單一用戶可承作多筆專案，方便依不同用途進行資金分流，活動即日起至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止 (若額滿將提前截止)。
除了定存方案外，針對首次開立 Richart 數位存款帳戶的新用戶，業者亦推出相關搭配方案。新戶開啟指定優利子帳戶後，可享有 30 萬元額度內 3.5% 的優惠活儲利率；同時於開戶時輸入專屬代碼「2026RT200」並完成登入，可另獲 200 元用戶禮。
隨著各大金融機構持續調整數位帳戶策略，業者試圖透過「高息活儲」與「多筆定存」的組合，吸引有短期資金避險與靈活運用需求的存款族群。台新 Richart 未來也將持續推出便利且具競爭力的數位金融方案，協助用戶更靈活運用每一筆資金，打造更安心、有效率的理財體驗。
paras_en: In response to recent market interest rate fluctuations and currency exchange rate volatility, public demand for stable returns and capital allocation has increased. Taiwan New Bank's digital brand Richart has announced the launch of a new round of 'New Capital New Taiwan Dollar Fixed Deposit Project', offering a 6-month annual interest rate of 2.2% and opening up single users to make multiple deposits to improve capital allocation flexibility.

According to Taiwan New Bank's observation, many investors during the currency exchange rate volatility period prefer to use fixed deposits as a reserve or short-term capital anchorage tool. Therefore, Richart has continued the previous interest rate scheme, expanding the capital allocation space, launching a 6-month fixed deposit with an annual interest rate of 2.2%, with a single deposit threshold of NT$100,000 and a maximum of NT$2 million.

Eligible new capital users are allowed to make multiple projects for a single user, making it convenient to allocate funds for different purposes, and the activity will start from today to September 30, 2026 (if full, it will be closed in advance).

In addition to the fixed deposit scheme, the company has also launched a related scheme for new users who open a Richart digital savings account for the first time. New users who open a specified high-interest savings account can enjoy a 3.5% interest rate for up to NT$300,000; at the same time, by inputting the exclusive code '2026RT200' and completing the login at the time of opening the account, they can also receive NT$200 in user gifts.

As major financial institutions continue to adjust their digital account strategies, companies are trying to attract short-term capital risk avoidance and flexible use demand through 'high-interest savings' and 'multiple fixed deposits' combinations. Taiwan New Richart will also continue to launch convenient and competitive digital financial schemes in the future to help users more flexibly use each piece of capital and create a more secure and efficient financial experience.

items.title: 東擎發表首款O-PAS認證工業物聯網控制器 加速關鍵工業數位轉型
items.title_en: Dongqing Announces First O-PAS Certified Industrial IoT Controller, Accelerating Key Industrial Digital Transformation
paras: 華擎 (3515-TW) 子公司東擎 (7710-TW) 今 (4) 日表示所開發工業物聯網控制器 iEP-5010G-010 正式成為全球首款通過 The Open Group O-PAS 開放流程自動化認證的產品，率領產業邁向開放且具備高互通性的自動化架構。
東擎科技表示本次通過認證的控制器符合 O-PAS 第二版標準規範，涵蓋系統管理與實體平台相關要求，同時已取得 IEC 62443-4-2 工業自動化與控制系統元件資安認證，築起堅實的資安防護基礎，可有效降低客戶對特定供應商的依賴，大幅簡化系統整合與設備升級流程。
在硬體架構與規格方面，該產品專為嚴苛工業環境設計，搭載英特爾 Atom x6425RE 處理器，採用堅固無風扇結構，支援 6 至 36V 直流寬電壓輸入與零下 40 度至 70 度的寬溫操作能力，能為流程自動化及各式極端環境提供穩定可靠的邊緣運算效能。
國際權威機構 The Open Group 開放流程自動化論壇對此指出，業界終端用戶一向重視獨立測試與驗證，東擎產品作為全球首家通過該認證計畫的設備，為全球流程自動化產業立下重要的國際里程碑。
東擎董事長李俊瑩表示，iEP-5010G-010 成為全球首款取得開放流程自動化 O-PAS™認證的產品，充分展現東擎持續推動開放式工業自動化發展、導入國際標準及技術創新的承諾。隨著工業基礎設施持續朝向更開放、更具互通性的架構發展，東擎將持續提供可靠的邊緣運算平台，協助客戶簡化系統整合、推動關鍵營運現代化，打造更具前瞻性的自動化系統。
paras_en: ASRock (3515-TW) subsidiary Dongqing (7710-TW) said today that its industrial IoT controller iEP-5010G-010 has become the world’s first product to receive The Open Group O-PAS Open Process Automation certification, leading the industry toward an open, highly interoperable automation architecture.

Dongqing Technology noted that the certified controller complies with the second edition of the O-PAS standard, covering system management and physical platform requirements, and has also obtained IEC 62443-4-2 certification for industrial automation and control system component cybersecurity, establishing a solid security foundation that can effectively reduce customers’ reliance on specific vendors and greatly simplify system integration and equipment upgrade processes.

In terms of hardware architecture and specifications, the product is designed for harsh industrial environments, featuring an Intel Atom x6425RE processor, a rugged fan‑less design, support for a wide DC input range of 6 V to 36 V, and an operating temperature range from –40 °C to 70 °C, providing stable and reliable edge‑computing performance for process automation and extreme conditions.

The Open Group’s Open Process Automation Forum said that end‑users have always valued independent testing and verification, and Dongqing’s product, as the world’s first device to pass this certification program, marks an important international milestone for the global process automation industry.

Chairman Li Junying of Dongqing stated that the iEP-5010G-010, as the world’s first product to obtain the Open Process Automation O-PAS™ certification, fully demonstrates Dongqing’s commitment to advancing open industrial automation, adopting international standards, and driving technological innovation. As industrial infrastructure continues to evolve toward more open and interoperable architectures, Dongqing will keep delivering reliable edge‑computing platforms to help customers simplify system integration, modernize critical operations, and build more forward‑looking automation systems.

items.title: 〈房產〉非六都房貸壓力也不小  這兩縣市晚一年買房貸多扛逾百萬元
items.title_en: Non-6 Metropolitan Areas Face Significant Housing Loan Pressure, with Some Cities Experiencing Over $1.3 Million in Average Housing Loans
paras: 全台六都房價高，而非六都的買房壓力也不小。根據金融聯徵中心 2026 年首季新增房貸資料統計，非六都 15 個縣市當中，包括新竹縣、苗栗縣、彰化縣、嘉義縣及嘉義市，五個縣市平均房貸金額同步創下歷史新高。其中，房貸壓力最高的是新竹縣，首季平均房貸來到史上新高達 1347 萬元，增壓幅度也居冠，
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心執行長張旭嵐指出，近年都會區房價漲勢顯著，房市買氣也逐漸向周邊縣市外溢，尤其部分縣市因具備產業投資、人口移入及就業支撐紅利，更成為房市焦點。其中，新竹縣市受惠於新竹科學園區帶動大量科技人才就業與移居，竹北更發展成科技族群主要聚落，住宅需求穩定，也進一步推升周邊房市表現。
苗栗縣同樣受惠桃竹苗大矽谷計畫、新竹外溢效應，串聯竹南科學園區、頭份地區成為科技廊帶推升區段房價；嘉義縣市則有嘉義科學園區、台積電設廠及高鐵生活圈紅利，吸引自住與置產需求進駐，帶動房價補漲力道明顯，房貸規模也同步攀升。
張旭嵐表示，全台房市持續受信用管制影響，投資買盤轉趨保守，市場資金逐漸回歸自住需求，而非六都房市向來以在地自住基本盤為主，因此價量波動相對小。且青安 3.0 接續支撐首購市場，婚育家庭有機會貸到 1500 萬，而目前這些縣市的貸款金額多數落在千萬之內，總價也符合門檻，又具產業題材優勢，有利首購族兼顧就業與自住規劃。
觀察非六都各縣市今年首季房貸統計，除了南投、基隆、花東地區主力購屋年齡層落在 40-50 歲，其他縣市多以 30-40 歲的青壯族群為主力，且部分地區年輕族群占比有增加的趨勢。
另，約有 6 成縣市購屋偏好 3 年內新屋，產品類型除了鍾情透天宅，包括新竹縣市、苗栗縣、嘉義市等縣市，均有超過半數購屋族，偏好住宅大樓。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心經理李家妮表示，六都以外地區普遍因青壯年人口外移，部分縣市購屋主力年齡層相對偏高，像嘉義縣市、苗栗等具備產業投資與就業機會的城市，近年受惠科技園區、重大建設帶動，吸引買氣回流，也拉抬年輕購屋族佔比逐步提升。相較都會區高房價，多數首購族受限於預算，往往得在屋齡、坪數與地段間取捨，非六都多數縣市房價相對親民，在相同預算下，更有機會入手屋齡新穎、坪數更大的住宅，甚至透天產品。
以苗栗主要房貸熱區頭份市，總價 1500 萬元以內，仍有機會入手新大樓 3 房含車位，嘉義市總價千萬元就有機會，吸引不少在地年輕家庭首購，滿足成家及長期自住需求，尤其仰賴青安優貸助攻，也讓首購族更願意進場卡位。
paras_en: While housing prices in the six metropolitan areas are high, non-6 metropolitan areas also face significant housing loan pressure. According to the Financial Information Center's 2026 first-quarter data on new housing loans, among the 15 non-6 metropolitan areas, including Hsinchu County, Miaoli County, Changhua County, Chiayi County, and Chiayi City, the average housing loan amount in five counties reached a new historical high.
Among these counties, Hsinchu County has the highest housing loan pressure, with an average first-quarter housing loan of NT$134.7 million, a significant increase.

Taiwan Housing Group Trend Center Executive Director Zhang Xuanlan pointed out that in recent years, housing prices in metropolitan areas have risen significantly, and housing market demand has gradually shifted to surrounding counties. In particular, some counties have become hotspots due to their industrial investment, population influx, and employment benefits.

Hsinchu County, for example, has benefited from the Hsinchu Science Park, attracting a large number of technology professionals and residents, making it a major hub for the tech community. This has led to stable residential demand and further boosted the surrounding housing market.

Miaoli County has also benefited from the Taichung-Miaoli-Sanxia (TMS) plan and the Hsinchu spillover effect, linking the Hsinchu Science Park, the Head of the Science Park, and the Taichung Science Park to form a technology corridor, driving up housing prices in the area.

Chiayi County has the Chiayi Science Park, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) facilities, and the high-speed rail living circle, attracting residents and investors, driving up housing prices and loan amounts.

Zhang Xuanlan noted that the Taiwan housing market has been affected by credit control, with investment demand becoming more conservative, and market funds returning to self-occupancy demand. Non-6 metropolitan areas have traditionally relied on local self-occupancy demand, so price and quantity fluctuations are relatively small.

The 3.0 version of the 'An An' policy has continued to support first-time homebuyers, allowing them to borrow up to NT$150 million. Currently, most loan amounts in these counties are in the range of NT$10 million to NT$20 million, which is within the budget, and they also have the advantage of industrial-themed products, making it easier for first-time homebuyers to balance employment and self-occupancy plans.

Observing the first-quarter housing loan data for non-6 metropolitan areas, it is found that, except for Nantou, Keelung, and the eastern coast, most counties have a main purchasing age group of 30-40 years old, and some areas have seen an increase in the proportion of young people.

In addition, about 60% of counties prefer to buy new homes within 3 years, and the product type is popular with transparent houses. Among the counties, Hsinchu County, Miaoli County, and Chiayi City have more than half of their buyers preferring residential buildings.

Taiwan Housing Group Trend Center Manager Lee Jian-Ni pointed out that non-6 metropolitan areas are generally affected by the outflow of young people, and some counties have a relatively older main purchasing age group. However, cities with industrial investment and employment opportunities, such as Chiayi County and Miaoli County, have benefited from the Hsinchu Science Park and major construction projects, attracting buyers and driving up the proportion of young people purchasing homes.

Compared to the high housing prices in metropolitan areas, most first-time homebuyers are limited by their budget and often have to make trade-offs between age, area, and location. Non-6 metropolitan areas have relatively affordable housing prices, making it easier for first-time homebuyers to purchase new, larger homes, even transparent products.

In Miaoli County's main housing loan area, Head of the Science Park, with a total price of NT$15 million, it is still possible to purchase a new residential building with 3 units and a parking lot. In Chiayi City, with a total price of NT$10 million, it is possible to purchase a new residential building, attracting many young local families to purchase their first home, meeting their needs for family and long-term self-occupancy, especially with the help of the 'An An' preferential loan, making it more willing for first-time homebuyers to enter the market and secure a home.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉Lumentum示警磷化銦缺料危機 聯亞、全新逾5檔亮燈漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Lumentum Warns of Indium Phosphide Shortage Crisis, Leading to Over 5 Stocks Surging to Limit Up
paras: 美國光通訊大廠 Lumentum(LITE-US) 執行長 Michael Hurlston 在法國巴黎舉行的 AI 峰會上示警，磷化銦 (InP) 是 AI 資料中心中雷射元件中不可或缺的化合物半導體，將面臨比記憶體更嚴重的供應危機，今 (4) 日與磷化銦高度相關三五族類股聯亞 (3081-TW)、全新 (3081-TW) 等近 5 檔亮燈攻上漲停價。
據 Michael Hurlston 透露，Lumentum 目前擁有 5 座磷化銦晶圓廠，但出貨量仍比客戶需求缺少 30% 以上，缺口比起上 1 季還要更大，包括將 Lumentum 與 Coherent(COHR-US) 產能加起，恐怕都無法滿足輝達 (NVDA-US) 與其他客戶開出的需求量，也激勵激勵今日磷化銦概念股全面噴發。
盤面上，除了聯亞、全新，包括環宇 - KY(4991-TW)、IET-KY(4971-TW)、穩懋 (3105-TW) 等逾 5 檔攜手攻上漲停板，宏捷科 (8086-TW) 也漲幅超過半根停版。
法人指出，磷化銦供應受限的原因不只在於製造能力，更涉及原料來源的先天限制與地緣政治風險，使整體供應鏈面臨結構性的缺料瓶頸。
分析師則表示，今日光通訊類股表現持續強勁，主要以三五族磷化銦相關類股為主，目前從股價觀察，還有反彈空間，因之前多檔跌深破月線，投資人可觀察相關營收，擇優進場持續布局。
paras_en: Lumentum (LITE-US) CEO Michael Hurlston warned at the AI Summit in Paris that indium phosphide (InP) will face a more severe supply crisis than memory, a crucial compound semiconductor in laser components of AI data centers. On April 4, related stocks such as Unison (3081-TW), Unison (3081-TW), and over 5 other stocks lit up and surged to the limit up.

According to Michael Hurlston, Lumentum currently has 5 indium phosphide wafer factories, but the output still lags behind customer demand by over 30%, with a larger gap than the previous quarter. Even combining Lumentum's and Coherent (COHR-US) production capacity, it may not be enough to meet the demand of NVIDIA (NVDA-US) and other customers, prompting a comprehensive explosion of indium phosphide concept stocks today.

On the market, in addition to Unison and Unison, over 5 stocks such as Ring Universe (4991-TW), IET-KY (4971-TW), and Stable (3105-TW) also surged to the limit up, with Macrojet (8086-TW) exceeding half a root stop.

Experts pointed out that the limited supply of indium phosphide is not only due to manufacturing capacity, but also involves inherent limitations of raw material sources and geographical political risks, making the overall supply chain face a structural shortage bottleneck.

Analysts noted that the performance of communication stocks continues to be strong, mainly led by three-five family indium phosphide-related stocks. From the current stock price observation, there is still room for rebound, as many stocks have fallen deeply below the monthly line. Investors can observe the related revenue and choose to enter the market for continuous layout.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉緯穎AI伺服器看旺獲外資喊高目標價 股價衝破6300元飆天價
items.title_en: Focus Stock: WeiYi AI Server Sees Strong Demand, Foreign Investors Raise Target Price
paras: 緯穎 (6669-TW) 持續受惠通用型伺服器需求提升，加上 AI 伺服器帶動、CSP 客戶上修資本支出，美系外資預期，緯穎第三季營收季對季可望成長 28%，並上調目標價至 1 萬元，激勵緯穎今 (4) 日股價衝破 6000 元，最高漲至 6385 元，再創歷史新天價。
緯穎今天早盤以 5935 元開高，雖盤中一度翻黑跌至 5800 元，不過隨後翻紅走高，最高衝上 6385 元，大漲逾半根停板，截至 11 點，股價暫報 6185 元，漲幅超過 4%，排名千金股第 5 名，成交量超過 4000 張。
緯穎伺服器業務展望正向，AI 伺服器方面，美系 CSP 客戶自第二季起，持續拉貨 ASIC 產品，出貨穩健；通用型伺服器也在代理式 AI 帶動下，需求持續升溫，下半年營運可期。
緯穎第二季營收 2781.53 億元，季增 0.6%，年增 26%；累計今年上半年營收 5546.6 億元，年增 42%。緯穎將於本周五 (7 日) 公告第二季財報，並釋出最新展望。
paras_en: WeiYi (6669-TW) continues to benefit from the surge in demand for general-purpose servers, as well as the growth of AI servers, and CSP customers' increased capital expenditures. Foreign investors expect WeiYi's third-quarter revenue to grow by 28% quarter-over-quarter, and have raised their target price to NT$10,000, driving the stock price to break through NT$6,300 and reach a new historical high of NT$6,385.

WeiYi's stock price opened at NT$5,935 in the morning session, but briefly fell to NT$5,800 before rebounding and reaching a high of NT$6,385, with a gain of over 50% above the stop-loss price. As of 11:00, the stock price was NT$6,185, with a gain of over 4%, ranking fifth among the top stocks. The trading volume exceeded 4,000 shares.

WeiYi's server business outlook is positive, with AI servers seeing steady demand from US-based CSP customers, who have been continuously ordering ASIC products since the second quarter. Meanwhile, general-purpose servers have seen increasing demand driven by proxy AI, and the company's operations are expected to improve in the second half of the year.

WeiYi's second-quarter revenue was NT$278.15 billion, up 0.6% quarter-over-quarter and 26% year-over-year. The company's cumulative revenue for the first half of the year was NT$554.66 billion, up 42% year-over-year. WeiYi will announce its second-quarter earnings report on Friday (July 7) and release its latest outlook.

items.title: Google表外擔保暴增至438億美元！豪賭AI、換取TPU銷售動能
items.title_en: Google’s Off‑Balance‑Sheet Guarantees Surge to $43.8 B! Betting Big on AI to Boost TPU Sales
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）軍備競賽白熱化之際，Google 母公司 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 正悄悄向華爾街的金融工程借力，用一套過去鮮少出現在科技巨頭身上的手法，即透過大規模表外擔保，來為自研 AI 晶片鋪路。
根據 Alphabet 最新揭露的財報資訊，該公司為資料中心租戶提供的潛在違約擔保，其「名目金額」已從去年九月底的 65 億美元，一口氣暴增近六倍，來到 438 億美元。
這也代表，一旦擔保對象出現財務問題，Google 最壞情況下可能需要承擔的支付責任，已達到數百億美元等級。

用擔保換市占：TPU 對抗輝達的另一條路

根據《The Information》報導，這波擔保潮的背後，是 Google 推廣自家張量處理器（TPU）的野心。
相較於輝達 (NVDA-US) 的 AI 晶片，TPU 若要打入更多資料中心與客戶（例如 Anthropic），往往需要開發商能以較低成本取得融資。
而 Google 提供的財務擔保，正好能替這些資料中心開發商增加信用背書，讓他們更容易借到便宜的錢、加快機房興建速度。
換言之，Google 正用自己的資產負債表當作籌碼，以換取 TPU 在市場上的擴張空間。
知情人士向媒體透露，Google 內部評估後認為，未來 TPU 銷售所帶來的營收，將遠遠超過這些擔保可能造成的財務負擔，高層對這筆帳相當有信心。
目前，Google 已針對約十個資料中心專案、合計約 2.4 吉瓦的電力容量提供了擔保，不過由於相關工程都還沒完工，這些擔保實際上尚未啟動。
值得留意的是，這類交易多半有固定的三角結構：雲端新創公司 Fluidstack 負責承租與規劃資料中心，並在裡面裝設 TPU，再將運算力轉租給 Anthropic 等終端使用者。
而 Hut 8 (HUT-US) 、TeraWulf (WULF-US) 這類原本從事加密貨幣挖礦、如今轉型投入 AI 基礎設施的業者，則常是資料中心的實際營運方。

帳面數字看似驚人 實際風險受控？

儘管 438 億美元的名目擔保金額十分嚇人，但真正記錄在 Alphabet 資產負債表上的公允價值，其實只有 8.15 億美元。
這是因為「名目價值」代表的是最極端情境下的最大可能損失，而公允價值才是 Google 根據違約機率、違約時間點與可回收金額等假設，估算出的實際預期支出。
信評機構 CreditSights 技術研究主管 Jordan Chalfin 指出，外界不需要對這個名目數字過度緊張，因為有多重機制能緩解風險。
舉例來說，若租戶違約，Google 通常有權接手底層的租約，自行使用或轉租給其他客戶，等於變相取得了稀缺的運算容量；再加上許多租約長達十五年，潛在的風險敞口會隨時間逐步遞減。
Fitch Ratings 信用分析師 Anubhav Arora 則坦言，評等機構之所以願意給這些資料中心專案投資等級評等，「高度仰賴 Google 提供的擔保」作為信用支撐。
他預期這股趨勢短期內不會停歇，畢竟 Google 過去十二個月的營運現金流超過 1850 億美元，融資實力仍相當雄厚。

資產負債表大變身：從「零負債」神話到近千億美元舉債

Alphabet 長年給外界的印象，是現金水位極高、幾乎不需要靠負債擴張的穩健企業。然而，這樣的形象正快速瓦解。
截至六月底，Alphabet 的債務規模已從一年前的 236 億美元，暴增至 980 億美元；公司並在二十多年來首次發行新股籌資。上季財報更顯示，Alphabet 作為上市公司，史上首度出現自由現金流為負的季度。
除了已生效的 438 億美元擔保外，Alphabet 另外還簽下總額 852 億美元、尚未正式啟動的表外資料中心租賃合約；為協助合作夥伴取得電力與能源設備，又額外提供了 76 億美元的後備擔保，並已承諾在條款拍板後，再追加 241 億美元的未來擔保額度。
分析人士指出，這股靠表外工具支撐 AI 建設的風潮並非 Google 獨有。Meta(META-US) 透過在路易斯安那州、德州成立少數股權合資企業，把資料中心建設成本移出自家資產負債表。
此外，甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 同樣仰賴類似的表外安排來支應擴張野心。AI 基礎設施的燒錢速度，正迫使科技巨頭們一齊向華爾街的融資手法靠攏。

提供擔保也要分一杯羹：認股權證鎖住上檔獲利

有趣的是，Google 在承擔下檔風險的同時，也沒忘記為自己爭取上檔利益。
在部分交易中，Google 會以提供擔保為條件，向資料中心開發商換取股權認股權證。換言之，若這些公司股價表現亮眼，Google 也能跟著受惠。
例如，在紐約州巴克為 Fluidstack 興建資料中心的 TeraWulf，Google 握有的認股權證相當於該公司 14% 股權；在與 Cipher Digital 的合作案中，Google 也取得價值相當於 5.4% 股權的認股權證。
一旦 Google 選擇提前終止擔保，雖然可能得向債券持有人支付一大筆一次性費用，但這筆錢實質上會轉化為對該專案的所有權權益。
不過並非所有交易都如此對等。以 Hut 8 的合作案為例，Fitch Ratings 指出，若 Fluidstack 違約，Google 必須概括承受長達十五年租期的全部付款義務，而且一旦工程出現重大延誤，雙方都無法片面解除合約。
更特別的是，Google 在這筆交易中並未取得任何認股權證。Hut 8 執行長 Asher Genoot 在財報電話會議上透露，這筆資料中心租約總價值達 70 億美元，另加約 20 億美元的電力與財產稅保險等費用。
知情人士表示，這筆交易條件特殊，外界普遍認為未來不太可能複製。
paras_en: As the AI arms race heats up, Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Google’s parent, is quietly tapping Wall Street’s financial engineering, using a technique rarely seen at tech giants: massive off‑balance‑sheet guarantees to pave the way for its own AI chips.

According to Alphabet’s latest disclosed financials, the potential default guarantees it provides to data‑center tenants have a "nominal amount" that jumped from $6.5 billion at the end of September last year to nearly six times that, reaching $43.8 billion.
That means, if a guaranteed party runs into financial trouble, Google could be on the hook for payments in the hundreds of billions of dollars in a worst‑case scenario.
Using Guarantees to Gain Market Share: TPU’s Alternative Path Against Nvidia
The wave of guarantees, reported by The Information, is driven by Google’s ambition to push its own Tensor Processing Units (TPUs).
Compared with Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) AI chips, TPUs need developers to obtain financing at lower cost in order to win more data‑centers and customers such as Anthropic.
Google’s financial guarantees give those data‑center developers a credit endorsement, making it easier for them to borrow cheap money and speed up facility construction.
In other words, Google is using its balance sheet as a bargaining chip to expand TPU market reach.

Insiders told the media that internal assessments show future TPU‑related revenue will far outweigh any financial burden from the guarantees, and senior management is very confident about the accounting line.

So far Google has provided guarantees for about ten data‑center projects covering roughly 2.4 GW of power capacity, but because the projects are not yet completed, the guarantees have not been triggered.

These deals typically follow a triangular structure: the cloud‑startup Fluidstack leases and plans the data center, installs TPUs inside, and then sub‑leases compute capacity to end users such as Anthropic.
Companies that originally mined cryptocurrency, such as Hut 8 (HUT-US) and TeraWulf (WULF-US), have pivoted to AI infrastructure and often act as the actual operators of the data centers.
The headline figure of $43.8 billion looks alarming, but the fair‑value amount recorded on Alphabet’s balance sheet is only $815 million.

The "nominal value" reflects the maximum possible loss in an extreme scenario, whereas fair value is the expected outflow Google estimates based on default probability, timing and recoverable amounts.
Credit‑rating firm CreditSights’ technical research head Jordan Chalfin says the market need not overreact to the nominal number because multiple mechanisms mitigate risk.

For example, if a tenant defaults, Google usually has the right to take over the underlying lease, use the space itself or re‑lease it to another customer, effectively acquiring scarce compute capacity; many leases run up to fifteen years, so exposure diminishes over time.

Fitch Ratings analyst Anubhav Arora notes that rating agencies are willing to give these data‑center projects investment‑grade ratings largely because of the “highly relied‑upon” guarantees from Google.
He expects the trend to continue in the short term, given Alphabet’s operating cash flow of over $185 billion in the past twelve months, which shows strong financing capacity.
Balance‑Sheet Transformation: From a "Zero‑Debt" Myth to Nearly $100 Billion of Borrowing
Alphabet has long cultivated an image of a cash‑rich, virtually debt‑free, ultra‑stable company, but that perception is rapidly eroding.

As of the end of June, Alphabet’s debt rose from $23.6 billion a year ago to $98 billion, and the company issued new equity for the first time in more than two decades. Its most recent quarterly report even showed a negative free‑cash‑flow quarter for the first time in history.

In addition to the $43.8 billion of guarantees already in effect, Alphabet has signed off‑balance‑sheet data‑center lease contracts totaling $85.2 billion that have not yet been activated; it also provided a $7.6 billion backup guarantee to help partners secure power and equipment, and has pledged an additional $24.1 billion of future guarantees once the terms are finalized.

Analysts point out that this wave of off‑balance‑sheet tools to fund AI builds is not unique to Google. Meta (META-US) has created minority‑equity joint ventures in Louisiana and Texas to move data‑center construction costs off its own balance sheet.

Oracle (ORCL-US) similarly relies on comparable off‑balance‑sheet arrangements to fund its expansion ambitions. The cash‑burn rate of AI infrastructure is pushing the tech giants toward Wall Street‑style financing.
Guarantees Also Earn a Slice of the Upside: Warrants Lock In Potential Gains
Interestingly, while Google assumes downside risk, it also secures upside upside by extracting equity‑linked warrants in some transactions.
In certain deals, Google provides guarantees in exchange for stock warrants from the data‑center developers. If those companies’ shares perform well, Google benefits as well.

For example, in the TeraWulf data‑center that Fluidstack is building in Buck, New York, Google holds warrants equivalent to 14 % of the company’s equity; in its partnership with Cipher Digital, Google obtained warrants representing roughly 5.4 % of the equity.
If Google chooses to terminate a guarantee early, it may have to pay a large one‑time fee to bondholders, but that payment effectively converts into an ownership stake in the project.

However, not all transactions are structured that way. In the Hut 8 deal, Fitch Ratings notes that if Fluidstack defaults, Google would have to assume the full payment obligations for the entire fifteen‑year lease, and any major construction delay would prevent either party from unilaterally walking away.

Moreover, Google did not receive any warrants in that particular transaction. Hut 8 CEO Asher Genoot told the earnings call that the data‑center lease is valued at $7 billion, plus roughly $2 billion in power, property‑tax and insurance costs.
Insiders say the terms of that deal are unique and unlikely to be replicated elsewhere.

items.title: 美AI股反彈動能本周迎「硬門檻」！華爾街估7月非農就業新增8.5萬人 Kalshi押7萬區間
items.title_en: US AI Stocks Face "Hard Threshold" This Week as Wall Street Expects 850,000 July Non-Farm Payroll Additions
paras: 美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 本週五 (7 日) 將公布 7 月非農就業新增人數，道瓊斯經濟學家一致預期新增 8.5 萬人、失業率 4.3%，《路透社》調查中位數落在 8.3-8.5 萬人，巴克莱等樂觀派看 10 萬，相較於 6 月僅增 5.7 萬、失業率 4.2%，市場實質押注「低成長但未失速」的溫和放緩。
對全球股票多頭、尤其半導體與 AI 算力鏈而言，週五數據是 7 月底暴力反彈後第一道硬門檻。6 月非農就業人數爆冷至僅新增 5.7 萬人後，「升息預期降溫」讓那指與費半指數獲得喘息機會。
最理想情境是新增 7 萬至 10 萬人、失業率穩在 4.2% 至 4.3%、薪資續降的「金髮姑娘」組合，既證明消費與企業獲利未滑向衰退，又不逼聯準會 (Fed) 強化升息路徑，壓低實質利率與折現率，這對長期、估值敏感的 HBM、網通與 AI 應用股屬於利多。
但付費預測市場搶跑華爾街。Kalshi 與 Polymarket 真金白銀押注者認為，7 月新增逾 8 萬人機率僅 47%、超 7 萬人約 60%、達 9 萬人約 41%、破 10 萬人略高於三分之一，不到 6 萬人機率約三分之一。
Kalshi 上月曾押注 6 月超 12.5 萬機率 63%，結果最終 5.7 萬，預測盤同樣看走眼。
不過，若新增破 10 萬人且薪資增幅重新加速，聯準會 9 月升息機率 (當前約 64% 至 68%) 與長債殖利率回彈，30 年期美債曾觸 5.24% 至 5.27%，高估值 AI 股吃不下第二輪利率衝擊。
若低於 6 萬人且失業率彈升、工時萎縮，債市初步上漲後邏輯會切至「獲利衰退」，週期、金融、出口鏈將先受到影響。
油價周一 (3 日) 收跌約 5%、美債殖利率回落帶動標普 500 指數收漲 1.48%、那指漲 2.13%，多頭依賴的正是「油價降＋利率降＋科技獲利韌性」三大利多共振。
專家指出，非農數據不是單一利多，而是把 7 月槓桿強平後的技術修復，升格為新一輪風險偏好上行、或是打回高波動回補的分水嶺。
paras_en: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is set to release the July non-farm payroll additions on Friday, with Wall Street economists unanimously expecting an addition of 850,000 jobs and a 4.3% unemployment rate. A Reuters survey puts the median estimate at 830,000 to 850,000, while Barclays and other optimistic analysts predict 1 million additions, compared to the 570,000 additions in June and a 4.2% unemployment rate. The market is essentially betting on a "soft landing" with moderate growth but no slowdown.

For global stock bulls, particularly those in the semiconductor and AI computing chains, Friday's data will be the first "hard threshold" since the violent rebound at the end of July. After the June non-farm payroll additions came in at a disappointing 570,000, "dovish" expectations of interest rate hikes gave the Nasdaq and the Philly Fed Index a breather.

The ideal scenario would be an addition of 700,000 to 1 million jobs, a stable unemployment rate of 4.2% to 4.3%, and a decline in wages, which would prove that consumption and corporate profits have not yet slid into a recession, while also not forcing the Federal Reserve (Fed) to strengthen its interest rate hike path, thereby lowering the effective interest rate and discount rate. This would be a positive for long-term, value-sensitive stocks in HBM, telecom, and AI applications.

However, paid prediction markets are beating Wall Street to the punch. Kalshi and Polymarket's silver-tongued bettors believe that the probability of adding over 800,000 jobs is only 47%, while exceeding 700,000 jobs is around 60%, reaching 900,000 jobs is approximately 41%, and breaking 1 million jobs is slightly above one-third. The probability of adding less than 600,000 jobs is around one-third.
Kalshi had previously bet on a 63% probability of exceeding 12.5 million jobs in June, but the actual number came in at 570,000, with the prediction market also looking over-optimistic.

However, if the additions exceed 1 million and wages growth accelerates, the Fed's interest rate hike probability in September (currently around 64% to 68%) and the long-term bond yield will rebound, with the 30-year US Treasury yield touching 5.24% to 5.27%, which would be a second-round shock for high-valued AI stocks.

If the additions are below 600,000 and the unemployment rate rises, with hours worked declining, the bond market will initially rally before logic shifts to "profit decline," with cyclicals, financials, and export chains being the first to be affected.

Oil prices fell by around 5% on Monday, with the 10-year Treasury yield decline driving the S&P 500 index up 1.48% and the Nasdaq up 2.13%, with bulls relying on the "oil price down + interest rate down + tech profit resilience" triple bullish synergy.

Experts point out that non-farm payroll data is not a single bullish factor, but rather a technical repair of the July 7th strong flattening, which has been upgraded to a new round of risk-on, or a dividing line for high volatility to rebound.

items.title: 蘋果20週年大改版！iPhone 20傳採玻璃超薄機身 散熱再升級
items.title_en: Apple 20th Anniversary iPhone 20 Rumored to Feature Glass Body and Improved Cooling
paras: 蘋果傳出計畫在 2027 年底推出 iPhone 問世 20 週年紀念機型，市場暫稱「iPhone 20」。最新消息指出，這款新機可能大量採用玻璃材質，並借鑑 iPhone Air 的超薄設計，同時擴大機身內部的散熱空間，以兼顧輕薄外型與效能表現。
微博爆料帳號「定焦數碼」近日表示，iPhone 20 的機身將以玻璃為主要材料，中框設計則可能接近 iPhone Air，整體厚度也有望維持在相近水準。
過去相關傳聞曾指出，蘋果可能為這款紀念機導入大面積曲面玻璃及固態按鍵，進一步減少傳統機械結構，打造更一體化的外觀。
這並非「定焦數碼」首次將 iPhone 20 與 iPhone Air 相提並論。該帳號 7 月便曾透露，蘋果準備讓週年紀念機型「回歸玻璃」，部分零組件可能沿用第一代 iPhone Air 採用的加工方式。
除了外觀變化，iPhone 20 的散熱能力也可能升級。
「定焦數碼」聲稱，新機內部的散熱板將擴大約「1 吋」，暗示蘋果可能為這款超薄機型配置面積更大的導熱結構，藉此提升長時間執行高負載工作的穩定性。
目前尚無法確定 iPhone 20 是否會直接採用均熱板散熱。
iPhone 17 Pro 系列已導入均熱板技術，可將 A19 Pro 晶片產生的熱量快速分散至機身其他區域；定位更輕薄的 iPhone Air 則未採用相同方案。
考量超薄機身通常更難處理熱量，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 若要進一步提升紀念機型的性能，導入均熱板具有一定合理性。
同一爆料來源先前也曾宣稱，折疊式 iPhone 將配置多組均熱板。不過，所謂散熱板面積增加，也可能只是代表蘋果擴大傳統導熱材料，而非確定採用均熱板。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週一 (3 日) 下滑約 1.8%，收在 303.42 美元，連續第四個交易日收黑，由於 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 市值超越蘋果，使蘋果跌至全美市值第三大企業。
paras_en: Apple is reportedly planning to release a 20th-anniversary iPhone model, dubbed 'iPhone 20,' in late 2027. According to the latest rumors, this new device may feature a glass body and adopt the ultra-thin design of the iPhone Air, while also expanding the internal cooling space to balance the lightweight exterior and performance.

A Weibo account called '定焦數碼' (Ding Jiao Shu Mu) recently claimed that the iPhone 20's body will be made of glass, with a middle frame design similar to the iPhone Air, and a thickness that may be similar to the Air.

Previous rumors suggested that Apple might introduce large-area curved glass and solid-state buttons for this commemorative model, further reducing traditional mechanical structures and creating a more integrated appearance.

This is not the first time '定焦數碼' has compared the iPhone 20 to the iPhone Air. The account revealed in July that Apple plans to let the anniversary model 'return to glass,' with some components possibly using the same processing method as the first-generation iPhone Air.
In addition to the exterior changes, the iPhone 20's cooling capabilities may also be upgraded.

'定焦數碼' claims that the new device's heat sink will be expanded by about '1 inch,' implying that Apple may equip this ultra-thin model with a larger heat-dissipation structure to improve stability during long periods of high-load work.
It is currently unclear whether the iPhone 20 will directly adopt the uniform heat plate cooling system.

The iPhone 17 Pro series has already introduced uniform heat plate technology, which quickly disperses heat generated by the A19 Pro chip to other areas of the device; in contrast, the thinner iPhone Air does not use the same scheme.

Considering that ultra-thin devices often have difficulty handling heat, Apple (AAPL-US) may have a rational reason to introduce uniform heat plates to further improve the performance of the commemorative model.

The same leak source previously claimed that the foldable iPhone would be equipped with multiple uniform heat plates. However, the increased heat sink area may simply represent Apple expanding traditional heat-dissipation materials rather than adopting uniform heat plates.

Apple (AAPL-US) fell by about 1.8% on Monday (3rd) to close at $303.42, marking its fourth consecutive trading day in the red. As Alphabet (GOOGL-US) surpassed Apple in market value, Apple dropped to the third-largest company in the US by market value.

items.title: 輝達卡關200美元區間 科技巨頭財報也未能助突破
items.title_en: Nvidia Stuck in $200 Range, Tech Giants' Earnings Also Fail to Break Through
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 股價周一 (3 日) 收高，扭轉盤中早些時候跌勢。不過，這家晶片大廠的股價似乎仍需要一份亮眼的財報，才能真正擺脫目前的盤整格局。
輝達股價終場上漲 2.9%，收在 206.64 美元，盤中一度漲至 208.74 美元。但過去三個月來，股價大致呈現橫盤整理，累計僅上漲 1.1%。
截至目前，本季財報季尚未為輝達帶來明顯催化劑。雖然多家科技巨頭陸續上調資本支出預測，但市場開始質疑，輝達是否仍會是最大受惠者，因記憶體晶片等其他 AI 硬體成本持續攀升，可能分食原本流向 GPU 的投資預算。
更大的問題在於，整體 AI 投資熱潮正受到借貸成本上升的影響而出現降溫跡象，使輝達股價難以持續突破。
此外，輝達近期透過資產負債表向 AI 新創企業提供融資的做法——《巴隆》形容其如「同時扮演創投與中央銀行」——也引發市場質疑。
21Shares 宏觀經濟研究主管 Stephen Coltman 在報告中表示，「許多過去現金流極為充沛的企業，如今為了投資 AI 基礎設施，不得不大舉舉債。即使是獲利能力最高、市值最大的輝達，也因傳出向客戶提供數千億美元規模的供應商融資與信用擔保，導致其信用利差擴大。」
不過，市場仍期待輝達將於 8 月 26 日公布的財報，有望成為股價突破盤整的重要催化劑，前提是投資人認為目前股價已具備足夠吸引力。
根據 FactSet，目前華爾街分析師對輝達的平均目標價為 314.29 美元。
今年以來，輝達股價累計上漲 10.8%，若以過去 12 個月計算，漲幅則達 14.8%。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares closed higher on Monday (the 3rd), reversing an earlier intraday decline. However, the chip maker still seems to need a standout earnings report to truly escape its current consolidation pattern.
Nvidia’s stock finished up 2.9% at $206.64, having peaked intraday at $208.74. Over the past three months the stock has essentially moved sideways, gaining only 1.1% in total.

So far this earnings season has not provided a clear catalyst for Nvidia. Although several tech giants have been raising their capital‑expenditure forecasts, the market is beginning to question whether Nvidia will remain the biggest beneficiary, as costs for other AI hardware such as memory chips continue to rise and could eat into the budget that would otherwise go to GPUs.
A bigger issue is that the overall AI investment boom is showing signs of cooling as borrowing costs rise, making it harder for Nvidia’s share price to sustain a breakout.

In addition, Nvidia’s recent practice of providing financing to AI startups through its balance sheet—described by Baron as “playing both venture capitalist and central bank”—has also drawn market skepticism.

Stephen Coltman, head of macro‑economic research at 21Shares, said in a report, “Many companies that once had abundant cash flow now have to take on large debt to invest in AI infrastructure. Even the most profitable and largest‑by‑market‑cap company, Nvidia, has seen its credit spread widen after reports that it is offering supplier financing and credit guarantees to customers worth hundreds of billions of dollars.”

Nevertheless, the market still hopes that Nvidia’s earnings report due on August 26 will serve as a key catalyst for breaking out of the range, provided investors deem the current price sufficiently attractive.
According to FactSet, Wall Street analysts currently have an average target price of $314.29 for Nvidia.
So far this year Nvidia’s stock has risen 10.8%, and over the past 12 months it has gained 14.8%.

items.title: 《大賣空》貝瑞警告美股恐「一片狼藉」！點「這一」被忽視潛在風險
items.title_en: Michael Burry Warns of Potential Risk in US Stock Market
paras: 《大賣空》原型、著名投資人貝瑞（Michael Burry），近日在其 Substack 平台發文警告，美股市場恐面臨一場多數投資人未曾留意的潛在風險，即由波動率交易策略基金所觸發的自動化拋售連鎖反應，可能導致股市急速崩跌。
根據《Business Insider》報導，貝瑞指出，一旦這類拋售潮爆發，恐讓相關持股陷入「大屠殺」的局面。
他以近期動能股的重挫為例，說明了這種情況可能如何發生。所謂動能股，指的是股價曾快速飆升的個股；隨著投資人近幾週獲利了結，並將資金自漲勢凌厲的記憶體與晶片類股中撤出，動能股跌勢明顯。
追蹤此類股票的安碩 MSCI 美國動能因子 ETF(MTUM-US) ，已較近期高點下挫達 14%。
貝瑞在文中警告：「這將留下一片血腥狼藉，但多數人根本沒料到會發生這種事。」
他認為，華爾街以波動率為核心的自動化交易基金，正成為當前市場的一大問題，因為如今的市場波動程度已較過去明顯升高。
貝瑞特別提到，股市在下跌時的反應似乎變得格外劇烈。所謂市場的「額外恐慌」指標，即市場在下跌日呈現出「不成比例的過度反應」，目前已攀升至 98 年來的最高水準。
不過，另一方面，市場在經歷劇烈拋售後，反彈速度也比過去快得多。貝瑞認為，這顯示市場波動很大一部分是由自動化交易程式所推動。
他寫道：「數據顯示，如今的投資人相較於過去，更容易因較小的虧損而感到不安，更傾向於在盤中逢低買進，也更可能經歷劇烈的市場混亂。」
貝瑞強調，沒有任何「真人」投資人會以這種方式運作。換句話說，他認為，現在市場的行為，已經不像真人投資人在交易，而是越來越像演算法或自動化交易程式在主導。
貝瑞進一步描繪了幾種可能情境，說明在部分基金高度槓桿操作下，以波動率為核心策略的基金如何可能引發股市大幅且突如其來的回檔。
他舉例指出，若標普 500 指數僅出現約 2.5% 的溫和跌幅，波動率策略基金便可能將股票曝險比重，從資產的 77% 降至約 50%，凸顯市場下行風險可能被大幅放大。
根據貝瑞針對標普 500 指數期貨合約的分析，目前以波動率為操作依據的基金，管理資產規模約達 5,000 億美元。
相較於規模高達 60 兆美元的美國整體股市，這個數字看似微不足道，但貝瑞警告，若這些自動化交易程式的拋售在同一時間集中爆發，仍足以對市場造成顯著衝擊。
他並表示，若一向有助於維持市場穩定的被動型投資人也開始跟進賣股，跌勢恐將進一步惡化。
談及波動率策略基金可能集中平倉的情況時，貝瑞寫道：「這將是一股極為龐大的力量，並向市場釋放各種動能，進一步被其他市場參與者放大。」
他接著表示，這波賣壓可能觸發大量停損單或風險管理機制，加劇市場下跌；不過，依據本十年以來的歷史經驗，市場最終仍將「比過去更快」恢復。
近來持續看空晶片股與 AI 概念股的貝瑞，多次警告本輪牛市累積的風險正逐步升高，尤其是在愈來愈多投資人開始質疑 AI 投資熱潮能否持續之際。
他近期也點名，美國私人信貸市場潛藏風險，同時警告 AI 產業中存在循環式交易現象，尤其是與輝達 (NVDA-US) 相關的交易結構，可能成為市場隱憂。
paras_en: Michael Burry, the legendary investor and prototype of "The Big Short", has recently warned on his Substack platform that the US stock market may face a potential risk that many investors have not noticed, triggered by the automated selling of volatility trading strategy funds, which could lead to a rapid collapse of the stock market.
According to a report by Business Insider, Burry pointed out that once this selling tide breaks out, it may put related stocks in a "bloodbath" situation.

He cited the recent decline of momentum stocks as an example, explaining how this situation could occur. Momentum stocks refer to stocks that have seen rapid price increases; as investors have taken profits in recent weeks and withdrawn funds from memory and chip stocks with strong momentum, momentum stocks have shown a clear decline.
The iShares MSCI USA Momentum Factor ETF (MTUM-US), which tracks these stocks, has fallen by 14% from its recent high.
Burry warned in his article: "This will leave a bloody mess, but most people don't think it will happen."

He believes that Wall Street's automated trading funds based on volatility are becoming a major problem in the current market, as the market's volatility has increased significantly compared to the past.

Burry particularly pointed out that the market's reaction to declines seems to have become extremely intense. The "excess panic" indicator, which shows the market's disproportionate overreaction on down days, has risen to its highest level in 98 years.

On the other hand, after experiencing intense selling, the market's rebound speed is much faster than in the past. Burry believes that this shows that a large part of the market's volatility is driven by automated trading programs.

He wrote: "The data shows that today's investors are more likely to feel uneasy about smaller losses than in the past, more likely to buy on dips during trading, and more likely to experience intense market chaos."

Burry emphasized that no "real" investor would operate in this way. In other words, he believes that the market's behavior is no longer like that of real investors trading, but is increasingly like algorithms or automated trading programs dominating.
Burry further depicted several possible scenarios, explaining how funds with high leverage and volatility-based strategies could trigger a sharp and sudden market correction.

He cited the example that if the S&P 500 index only experiences a mild decline of about 2.5%, volatility strategy funds may reduce their stock exposure from 77% of assets to around 50%, highlighting that the market's downside risk may be greatly amplified.
According to Burry's analysis of S&P 500 index futures contracts, funds operating based on volatility currently manage assets of around $500 billion.

Compared to the $60 trillion US stock market, this number seems insignificant, but Burry warned that if the automated trading programs' selling is concentrated at the same time, it could still have a significant impact on the market.
He also stated that if passive investors, who have always helped maintain market stability, start to follow suit and sell stocks, the decline may worsen.

When discussing the possibility of volatility strategy funds concentrated liquidation, Burry wrote: "This will be a very powerful force, releasing various energies into the market, which will be further amplified by other market participants."

He added that this selling pressure may trigger a large number of stop-loss orders or risk management mechanisms, exacerbating the market decline; however, based on historical experience over the past decade, the market will eventually "recover faster than in the past".

Burry, who has been bearish on chip stocks and AI concept stocks, has repeatedly warned that the risks accumulated in this bull market are gradually increasing, especially as more investors begin to question whether the AI investment boom can be sustained.

He has also pointed out that the US private credit market has hidden risks and warned of the existence of circular trading in the AI industry, particularly in transactions related to NVIDIA (NVDA-US), which could become a market concern.

items.title: 槓桿ETF規模逼近2500億美元！華爾街玩起「崩盤期權」 年化報酬率最高20%
items.title_en: Banks Turn to "Crash Puts" as Leveraged ETFs Approach $250 Billion
paras: 隨著全球槓桿 ETF 市場快速擴張，為其提供互換與槓桿支持的大型銀行，正日益倚重一類特殊場外衍生品「崩盤期權」（Crash Put），以轉移極端行情下可能面臨的尾部風險。
據彭博報導，高盛、巴克萊、花旗及法國巴黎銀行等大型投行均已積極布局這一市場。隨著槓桿 ETF 資產規模持續攀升，相關衍生品需求明顯升溫，其中高盛更向機構客戶推介相關交易，預期年化報酬率最高可達 14% 至 20%，吸引愈來愈多對沖基金與資產管理機構成為市場中的「保險提供者」。
所謂「崩盤期權」，本質上是一種為銀行提供尾部風險保障的場外衍生品，其出現與槓桿 ETF 本身存在的「缺口風險」（Gap Risk）有關。
以 2 倍槓桿 ETF 為例，若標的股票單日跌幅超過約 50%，基金淨值可能接近歸零，而作為互換交易對手的銀行，可能無法從 ETF 發行方收回全部損失。
在此情況下，銀行透過購買崩盤期權，提前將極端行情造成的損失轉移給外部投資者。當標的資產出現超預期暴跌時，由期權買方承擔相應風險，銀行則藉此降低自身曝險。
Kairos Investment Advisors 創辦人兼首席投資官 Ramon Verastegui 表示，這類交易本質上是一種高效率的「背靠背」風險轉移工具；Asym Research 創辦人 Rocky Fishman 則形容，其收益模式類似高收益債券，投資者持續獲取收益，但必須承擔極端事件發生時的損失。
崩盤期權需求快速升溫，背後原因在於槓桿 ETF 市場近年爆發式成長。彭博數據顯示，目前全球槓桿 ETF 資產規模已逼近 2500 億美元，美國市場更有超過 700 檔產品。雖然美國槓桿 ETF 管理規模在 6 月一度達到約 2000 億美元後回落至約 1600 億美元，但整體仍維持歷史高檔。
其中，SK 海力士 (000660KS) 、美光科技 (MU-US) 、輝達 (NVDA-US) 、特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 等高波動個股，已成為槓桿 ETF 熱門追蹤標的。Fishman 指出，部分 2 倍槓桿單股 ETF 所對應股票的波動率，甚至達到納斯達克 100 指數的 3 至 5 倍，使銀行管理相關產品的尾部風險難度高於 3 倍槓桿指數 ETF。
高收益也進一步推升機構投資者承接風險的意願。法國巴黎銀行推介資料顯示，今年 5 月，一筆針對 SK 海力士、履約價為股價 55%、期限最長 6 個月的單日缺口看跌期權，保費達 6.5%，三星電子相關產品保費也達 5.5%，高於今年 3 月時的 3.5% 與 2%。
同期，高盛向客戶推介的相關交易，在使用槓桿後，預期年化收益率可達 14.2% 至 20%。Janus Henderson 另類投資團隊組合經理 Natasha Sibley 表示，目前市場對這類產品的需求處於極高水準，銀行希望將風險轉移出去，而持續提高的收益率則吸引更多投資者提供避險資金。
不過，市場人士也警告，崩盤期權並非消除風險，而只是重新分配風險。由於相關產品主要透過場外交易完成，資訊透明度有限，市場難以精準掌握整體風險曝險。
Acadian Asset Management 組合經理 Owen Lamont 指出，歷史經驗顯示，槓桿、多重交易對手以及複雜金融創新的結合，往往可能放大金融市場的系統性風險。
隨著槓桿 ETF 持續擴張，圍繞其形成的互換交易與崩盤期權市場也將同步壯大。這類金融工具究竟能有效分散風險，或是在極端行情中成為放大市場衝擊的來源，已成為監管機構與市場參與者密切關注的議題。
paras_en: Banks are increasingly relying on a type of exotic derivative known as "crash puts" to mitigate the risks associated with leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) as the global market for these products continues to grow.

According to a report by Bloomberg, major banks such as Goldman Sachs, Barclays, JPMorgan Chase, and BNP Paribas have been actively building out their presence in this market. As the assets under management in leveraged ETFs continue to rise, the demand for these derivatives has also increased, with Goldman Sachs even offering them to institutional clients with expected annual returns of 14% to 20%.

The so-called "crash puts" are essentially a type of over-the-counter derivative that provides banks with protection against the risks associated with leveraged ETFs, particularly the "gap risk" that arises when the underlying stock price falls by more than 50% in a single day.

For example, if a 2x leveraged ETF is tracking a stock that falls by more than 50% in a day, the fund's net asset value could approach zero, leaving the bank that is acting as the counterparty to the trade with significant losses.

In this scenario, the bank can purchase a crash put to transfer the risk of extreme market movements to external investors. When the underlying asset experiences an unexpected decline, the buyer of the put option bears the corresponding risk, while the bank reduces its exposure.

Kairos Investment Advisors founder and chief investment officer Ramon Verastegui described this type of trade as a high-efficiency "back-to-back" risk transfer tool, while Asym Research founder Rocky Fishman compared its return profile to that of high-yield bonds, where investors receive continuous returns but must bear the risk of losses in extreme events.

The demand for crash puts has been rising rapidly, driven by the explosive growth of the leveraged ETF market. According to Bloomberg data, the global assets under management in leveraged ETFs have approached $250 billion, with over 700 products listed in the US market alone.

The US market for leveraged ETFs has seen a significant increase in assets under management, with a peak of around $200 billion in June, followed by a decline to around $160 billion in July. However, the overall level remains at historic highs.

Some of the most volatile stocks, such as SK Hynix (000660.KS), Micron Technology (MU.US), NVIDIA (NVDA.US), and Tesla (TSLA.US), have become popular tracking stocks for leveraged ETFs. Fishman noted that the volatility of some of these stocks is even higher than that of the Nasdaq 100 index, making it difficult for banks to manage the tail risk associated with these products.

The high returns offered by these products have also increased the willingness of institutional investors to take on risk. According to data from BNP Paribas, the premium for a single-day put option on SK Hynix with a strike price of 55% and a maturity of six months was 6.5% in May, while the premium for a similar option on Samsung Electronics was 5.5%, up from 3.5% and 2% in March.

Goldman Sachs has also been promoting similar trades to its clients, with expected annual returns of 14.2% to 20% after leverage. Janus Henderson's alternative investment team manager Natasha Sibley noted that the market demand for these products is at an all-time high, with banks seeking to transfer risk and investors attracted by the increasing returns.

However, market participants have warned that crash puts do not eliminate risk, but rather redistribute it. Since these products are primarily traded over-the-counter, transparency is limited, and the overall risk exposure is difficult to quantify.

Acadian Asset Management's portfolio manager Owen Lamont pointed out that historical experience has shown that the combination of leverage, multiple counterparties, and complex financial innovations can amplify systemic risk in financial markets.

As the leveraged ETF market continues to grow, the market for exchange-traded options and crash puts will likely expand in tandem. The effectiveness of these financial tools in diversifying risk or amplifying market shocks remains a closely watched issue by regulators and market participants.

items.title: 反向指標釋訊號 美股牛市有望續航
items.title_en: Bull Market May Continue as Investors Show Signs of Caution
paras: 《MarketWatch》專欄作家 Mark Hulbert 於周一 (3 日) 刊出文章指出，根據一項反向投資分析，近期市場走弱並非熊市的開端。
原因在於，在 6 月與 7 月市場劇烈震盪期間，短線市場擇時投資人大舉撤出股市。這與牛市見頂時常見的「投資人依然頑固看多」情況恰恰相反。
根據 Hulbert Nasdaq Newsletter Sentiment Index(HNNSI)，專注於那斯達克的短線市場擇時投資人，自今年夏季以來已大幅調降建議股票持股比重，顯示市場情緒迅速轉趨保守。
從 6 月 2 日高點至 7 月 29 日低點的 40 個交易日內，那斯達克綜合指數下跌 9.8%，同期 HNNSI 卻暴跌 84.4 個百分點。對反向投資人而言，這代表市場擇時投資人正築起一道堅實的「憂慮之牆」，而牛市往往就是沿著這道憂慮之牆一路攀升。
或許你會認為，市場下跌後，擇時投資人大幅撤出股市並不令人意外。畢竟在同一期間，由市值最大的 100 家那斯達克上市公司組成的那斯達克 100 指數下跌 11.3%，符合市場對「修正」約下跌 10% 的半官方定義。
那麼，市場下跌這麼多，投資人增加現金部位不是很正常嗎？
答案是「不是。」根據反向投資理論，如果投資人在市場下跌時仍不願減碼，反而代表市場存在危險的過度樂觀情緒。最經典例子就是 2000 年網路泡沫。當時那斯達克綜合指數自 2000 年 3 月高點首次下跌約 10% 後，市場擇時投資人反而提高股票持股比重。而後來發生的事情，市場都很清楚。
若將時間拉長觀察，自 2000 年以來所有 40 個交易日內那斯達克下跌至少 9.8% 的案例來比較，可以得到更完整結論。此次 HNNSI 下跌 84.4 個百分點，其跌幅超過歷史 79% 的同類案例。換句話說，這次市場擇時投資人的撤退速度，比過去大多數修正行情都還要劇烈。因此反向投資人認為，目前市場情緒完全談不上是頑固樂觀。
基於上述分析，反向投資人預期，美股短期內有機會重新反彈，朝歷史新高邁進。屆時，他們將密切觀察市場擇時投資人在下一波回檔時的反應。
如果市場再次出現修正，而這些投資人又迅速撤離股市，那麼反而等於再次替牛市續命，代表市場仍有大量悲觀情緒尚未消化，牛市仍有延續空間。
但若下一次市場回檔時，投資人依舊維持高度樂觀、不願減碼，那就可能意味著市場真正的風險正在累積，更深一波跌勢恐怕還在後頭。
反向投資人並不急著預測最終結果。他們選擇讓市場透過即時走勢告訴他們答案，而不是事先下結論。不過，就目前而言，他們仍預期美股短期內有望出現一波反彈。
paras_en: MarketWatch columnist Mark Hulbert wrote on Monday that a contrarian analysis suggests the recent market weakness is not the start of a bear market.

The reason is that during the market's sharp volatility in June and July, short-term market timers were heavily exiting the market, which is the opposite of the 'investors remain stubbornly bullish' scenario often seen at market tops.

According to the Hulbert Nasdaq Newsletter Sentiment Index (HNNSI), which focuses on short-term market timers, the group has significantly reduced their recommended stock allocation since the summer, indicating a rapid shift to a more conservative market sentiment.
During the 40 trading days from June 2 to July 29, the Nasdaq Composite Index fell 9.8%, while the HNNSI plummeted 84.4%.
For contrarians, this represents a strong 'wall of worry' being built by market timers, which is often a sign of a bull market.

You might think that market timers would be expected to heavily exit the market after a decline, but the fact that they did so in this case is not surprising, given that the Nasdaq 100 Index, which is composed of the 100 largest Nasdaq-listed companies by market value, fell 11.3% during the same period, which is in line with the unofficial definition of a correction of around 10%.

However, the answer is 'no'. According to contrarian theory, if investors are unwilling to reduce their exposure to the market even after a decline, it indicates a dangerous over-optimism in the market.
A classic example of this is the 2000 dot-com bubble, when market timers increased their stock allocation after the Nasdaq Composite Index first fell around 10% from its March 2000 high.
If we look at all 40-trading-day cases since 2000 where the Nasdaq Composite Index fell at least 9.8%, we can draw a more complete conclusion.
This time, the HNNSI fell 84.4%, which is more than 79% of the historical cases.
In other words, this time, the market timers' retreat is more severe than most correction scenarios.
Therefore, contrarians believe that the current market sentiment is not overly optimistic and that the market may have room to continue its bull run.
Based on this analysis, contrarians expect the US stock market to have a chance to rebound in the short term and reach new highs.
They will closely monitor the market timers' reaction to the next pullback.

If the market timers again quickly exit the market after a correction, it would be equivalent to giving the bull market another lease on life, indicating that there is still a large amount of bearish sentiment that has not been digested, and the bull market still has room to continue.

However, if the market timers remain overly optimistic and unwilling to reduce their exposure to the market even after the next pullback, it may indicate that the market is accumulating real risks and a deeper decline may be on the horizon.
Contrarians are not in a hurry to predict the final outcome and instead choose to let the market's current trend tell them the answer rather than making a preconceived conclusion.
However, based on the current situation, they still expect the US stock market to have a chance to rebound in the short term.

items.title: 光通訊成AI新瓶頸！Lumentum：這一「半導體材料」短缺恐比記憶體更嚴重
items.title_en: Lumentum Warns of Phosphorus Indium Shortage Threatening AI Supply Chain
paras: 隨著資料中心對光連接的需求呈指數級攀升，一種鮮少出現在鎂光燈下的化合物半導體材料磷化銦（InP），正迅速成為 AI 供應鏈中最脆弱的環節。業界人士示警，這波短缺的嚴重程度恐怕會超越當前眾所矚目的記憶體危機。
光學元件大廠 Lumentum(LITE-US) 執行長 Michael Hurlston 本月在巴黎舉行的 RAISE 峰會上直言，磷化銦的供應緊張程度將超越記憶體市場。
他透露，Lumentum 目前擁有五座磷化銦晶圓廠，但出貨量仍比客戶需求少了 30% 以上，而且這個缺口比上一季還要更大。
Hurlston 坦言：「就算把我們兩家（Lumentum 與 Coherent(COHR-US) ）的產能加在一起，恐怕都無法滿足輝達 (NVDA-US) 與其他客戶開出的需求量。」
市場研究機構 SemiAnalysis 也提出類似警告，指出應用於近封裝光連接的連續波分佈回饋（CW DFB）磷化銦雷射尤其吃緊。
目前，該產業的晶圓尺寸大多仍停留在二至四吋，與矽基 CMOS 晶片普遍採用的十二吋製程相差甚遠，產能擴張因此面臨結構性限制。
這些警訊已在市場掀起波瀾。輝達今年三月分別對 Lumentum 與 Coherent 各挹注二十億美元，試圖鎖定這兩家合計掌握全球多數高速光通訊雷射產能的供應商。
然而，相關個股近一個月來反而遭到重挫。Lumentum 重挫 22.3%，Coherent 大跌 37.6%，基板供應商 AXT 公司 (AXTI-US) 跌幅更達 39.9%，收發模組廠祥茂光電科技 (AAOI-US) 也下滑 35.7%，股價走勢與產業基本面明顯脫鉤。

矽光子繞不開磷化銦

分析指出，磷化銦之所以無可取代，關鍵在於材料本身的物理特性。
矽屬於間接能隙材料，只能負責導光、分光與調變光訊號，本身無法發光；磷化銦的直接能隙約為 1.34 電子伏特，能有效率地把電能轉換成光子。
這代表，不論是輝達、博通、邁威爾還是思科所推出的矽光子平台，封裝內部都必須內建磷化銦雷射作為光源。
換句話說，產業從可插拔收發模組走向共同封裝光學（CPO）架構，改變的只是雷射的安裝位置，並沒有讓磷化銦雷射從物料清單中消失。
事實上，CPO 架構還把雷射需求推向更難製造的高功率連續波光源與外部雷射模組，才能同時驅動多條光通道。而 Coherent 與輝達的合作內容，正好涵蓋這類高功率連續波雷射、外部雷射模組與光纖陣列元件。
輝達方面表示，其光子交換器相較於傳統可插拔方案，每埠所需雷射數量減少四倍，功耗效率提升 3.5 倍，網路韌性也提升十倍。
問題是，這些效益都是以「每埠」為單位計算，而真正推升需求曲線的，恰恰是傳輸埠總數的爆炸性成長。以 Spectrum-X Photonics 的高階配置為例，單一系統即可支援 512 個 800Gb/s 傳輸埠，總交換容量達到 400Tb/s。

從「千片」到「百萬片」的需求跳躍

Hurlston 用一組對比數字，勾勒出這波需求革命的力道。
電信客戶過去採購雷射的規模是「以百計」，而如今輝達與各大雲端業者的需求則是「以億計」。
他說：「要從數千片晶圓的規模，一口氣擴大到數百萬片，而且還是在非矽材料上進行，這絕非易事。」
數字也反映在財報上。Lumentum 最新一季營收達 8.084 億美元，年增 90%，其中元件業務營收 5.33 億美元，泵浦雷射出貨量年增 80%，但供需缺口依舊持續擴大。
Hurlston 在財報電話會議上表示，供需失衡程度已從上一季揭露的 25% 至 30%，進一步擴大至「逾 30%」，泵浦雷射的供應吃緊程度「甚至超乎預期」，核心元件「在可預見的未來實質上已經賣光」。
公司對下一季的營收指引落在 9.6 億至 10.1 億美元，營業利益率預估達 35% 至 36%。
Coherent 同樣繳出創紀錄的單季ㄏ營收 18 億美元，年增 21%，資料中心與通訊業務占總營收比重，已從約一年前的 41% 大幅躍升至 75%，訂單能見度更已排到 2028 年。
Coherent 執行長 Jim Anderson 表示，公司六吋磷化銦產線的設備良率已超越舊有的三吋產線，內部產能預計在 6 月底當季實現翻倍，較原訂計畫提前一季，並將在 2027 年底前再翻倍以上。

與記憶體危機的關鍵差異：時程

儘管警訊不斷，市場對這波短缺究竟會持續多久，看法仍相當分歧。
市調機構 LightCounting 在今年四月的預測顯示，目前收發模組的需求已超出供給約 30%，與 Lumentum 揭露的數字相符。
不過，該機構同時預估短缺將在 2026 年底前逐步緩解，並把今年乙太網路收發模組的成長率預測，從 2025 年的 82% 下修至 65%。
Coherent 將產能翻倍時程提前一季達成，也指向類似的樂觀方向。
與記憶體危機最大的不同在於，磷化銦短缺的出路，是一場已經在產線上實際運行、良率甚至超越舊製程節點的晶圓尺寸升級，而非動輒需要三年才能從零建成的全新晶圓廠，因此在一定程度上支撐了市場相對樂觀的時程預期。
不過 Hurlston 的警告同樣有其現實考量，畢竟他所帶領的公司，其市場評價在相當程度上，正繫於這波短缺究竟會延續多久。
分析指出，磷化銦供應受限的原因不只在於製造能力，更涉及原料來源的先天限制與地緣政治風險。作為鋅冶煉的副產品，銦的供應高度依賴鋅產業景氣與產量，無法因雷射器需求增加而快速提高產出，使整體供應鏈面臨結構性瓶頸。
paras_en: As data centers' demand for optical connections surges exponentially, a rare compound semiconductor material, Indium Phosphide (InP), is rapidly becoming the most vulnerable link in the AI supply chain. Industry insiders warn that this shortage may be more severe than the current memory crisis.
Lumentum (LITE-US) CEO Michael Hurlston warned at the RAISE summit in Paris this month that the supply tension of InP will surpass the memory market.
Hurlston revealed that Lumentum currently has five InP wafer factories, but the shipment volume is still less than 30% of customer demand, and this gap is even larger than last quarter.
He said, 'Even if we combine our two companies' (Lumentum and Coherent (COHR-US)) production capacity, it's unlikely we can meet the demand from NVIDIA (NVDA-US) and other customers.'

Market research firm SemiAnalysis also issued a similar warning, pointing out that the continuous wave distributed feedback (CW DFB) InP laser used in near-packaged optical connections is particularly tight.
Currently, the industry's wafer sizes are mostly stuck between 2-4 inches, far behind the 12-inch process widely adopted by silicon-based CMOS chips, making capacity expansion structurally limited.
