These warnings have caused a stir in the market. NVIDIA invested $20 billion in Lumentum and Coherent separately in March this year, trying to lock in these two companies, which together control most of the world's high-speed optical communication laser production capacity.

However, the relevant stocks have been hit hard in the past month. Lumentum plummeted 22.3%, Coherent plummeted 37.6%, and substrate supplier AXT (AXTI-US) plummeted 39.9%, while optical module manufacturer AAOI (AAOI-US) plummeted 35.7%, with stock prices diverging from the industry's fundamental situation.
Silicon photonics cannot bypass InP
Analysis points out that InP is irreplaceable due to its physical properties.

Silicon is an indirect bandgap material that can only be responsible for guiding, splitting, and modulating light signals, but it cannot emit light; InP has a direct bandgap of about 1.34 electron volts, which can efficiently convert electrical energy into photons.
This means that regardless of whether it's NVIDIA, Broadcom, Micron, or Cisco's silicon photonics platform, the internal packaging must embed InP lasers as light sources.

In other words, the industry's shift from plug-and-play optical modules to common packaged optics (CPO) architecture has only changed the location of the laser installation, but has not removed InP lasers from the material list.

In fact, the CPO architecture has pushed the demand for more difficult-to-manufacture high-power continuous wave light sources and external laser modules to drive multiple optical channels. The cooperation between Coherent and NVIDIA covers high-power continuous wave lasers, external laser modules, and fiber array components.

NVIDIA said that its photonic switchers require 1/4 of the lasers per port compared to traditional plug-and-play schemes, with power efficiency improved by 3.5 times and network resilience improved by 10 times.
However, these benefits are calculated per port, and the real driver of demand is the explosive growth of total transmission ports.
Hurlston used a set of comparative numbers to sketch the force of this demand revolution.
Telecom customers used to purchase lasers in 'thousands', while NVIDIA and major cloud companies now demand 'billions'.
He said, 'We need to expand from tens of thousands of wafers to hundreds of millions, and do it on non-silicon materials, which is no easy task.'

The numbers also reflect in the financial reports. Lumentum's latest quarter revenue reached $8.084 billion, up 90% year-over-year, with component business revenue reaching $5.33 billion, pump laser shipments up 80%, but the supply-demand gap still continues to expand.

Hurlston said in the earnings conference call that the supply-demand imbalance has expanded from the previously disclosed 25-30% to 'over 30%', and the supply tension of pump lasers is 'even worse than expected', and core components are 'essentially sold out' in the foreseeable future.
The company's guidance for the next quarter is between $9.6 billion and $10.1 billion, with a gross margin of 35-36%.

Coherent also reported a record-breaking single-quarter revenue of $18 billion, up 21% year-over-year, with data center and communication business accounting for 75% of total revenue, and order visibility extending to 2028.

Coherent CEO Jim Anderson said that the equipment yield of its six-inch InP production line has exceeded that of the old three-inch production line, and internal capacity is expected to double by the end of June this quarter, ahead of schedule, and will double again by the end of 2027.
The key difference from the memory crisis: timeline
Despite the warnings, the market's view on how long this shortage will last is still highly divided.
Market research firm LightCounting predicted in April this year that the demand for optical modules has exceeded supply by about 30%, consistent with Lumentum's numbers.
However, the firm also predicts that the shortage will gradually ease by the end of 2026, and has lowered its growth rate prediction for Ethernet optical modules from 82% in 2025 to 65%.
Coherent's production capacity doubling schedule has also been advanced to this quarter, pointing to a similar optimistic direction.

The main difference from the memory crisis is that the InP shortage has a solution that is already running on the production line, with yields even exceeding the old process nodes, rather than requiring a new wafer factory that takes three years to build, which to some extent supports the market's relatively optimistic timeline expectations.
However, Hurlston's warning also has its practical considerations, as his company's market valuation is heavily dependent on how long this shortage will last.

Analysis points out that the InP supply constraint is not only due to manufacturing capacity, but also involves inherent limitations and geographical risks of raw material sources. As a byproduct of zinc smelting, indium supply is highly dependent on the zinc industry's sentiment and production, and cannot be quickly increased due to laser demand, making the overall supply chain structurally bottlenecked.

items.title: Google表外擔保暴增至438億美元！豪賭AI、換取TPU銷售動能
items.title_en: Google’s Off‑Balance‑Sheet Guarantees Surge to $43.8 B! Betting Big on AI to Boost TPU Sales
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）軍備競賽白熱化之際，Google 母公司 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 正悄悄向華爾街的金融工程借力，用一套過去鮮少出現在科技巨頭身上的手法，即透過大規模表外擔保，來為自研 AI 晶片鋪路。
根據 Alphabet 最新揭露的財報資訊，該公司為資料中心租戶提供的潛在違約擔保，其「名目金額」已從去年九月底的 65 億美元，一口氣暴增近六倍，來到 438 億美元。
這也代表，一旦擔保對象出現財務問題，Google 最壞情況下可能需要承擔的支付責任，已達到數百億美元等級。

用擔保換市占：TPU 對抗輝達的另一條路

根據《The Information》報導，這波擔保潮的背後，是 Google 推廣自家張量處理器（TPU）的野心。
相較於輝達 (NVDA-US) 的 AI 晶片，TPU 若要打入更多資料中心與客戶（例如 Anthropic），往往需要開發商能以較低成本取得融資。
而 Google 提供的財務擔保，正好能替這些資料中心開發商增加信用背書，讓他們更容易借到便宜的錢、加快機房興建速度。
換言之，Google 正用自己的資產負債表當作籌碼，以換取 TPU 在市場上的擴張空間。
知情人士向媒體透露，Google 內部評估後認為，未來 TPU 銷售所帶來的營收，將遠遠超過這些擔保可能造成的財務負擔，高層對這筆帳相當有信心。
目前，Google 已針對約十個資料中心專案、合計約 2.4 吉瓦的電力容量提供了擔保，不過由於相關工程都還沒完工，這些擔保實際上尚未啟動。
值得留意的是，這類交易多半有固定的三角結構：雲端新創公司 Fluidstack 負責承租與規劃資料中心，並在裡面裝設 TPU，再將運算力轉租給 Anthropic 等終端使用者。
而 Hut 8 (HUT-US) 、TeraWulf (WULF-US) 這類原本從事加密貨幣挖礦、如今轉型投入 AI 基礎設施的業者，則常是資料中心的實際營運方。

帳面數字看似驚人 實際風險受控？

儘管 438 億美元的名目擔保金額十分嚇人，但真正記錄在 Alphabet 資產負債表上的公允價值，其實只有 8.15 億美元。
這是因為「名目價值」代表的是最極端情境下的最大可能損失，而公允價值才是 Google 根據違約機率、違約時間點與可回收金額等假設，估算出的實際預期支出。
信評機構 CreditSights 技術研究主管 Jordan Chalfin 指出，外界不需要對這個名目數字過度緊張，因為有多重機制能緩解風險。
舉例來說，若租戶違約，Google 通常有權接手底層的租約，自行使用或轉租給其他客戶，等於變相取得了稀缺的運算容量；再加上許多租約長達十五年，潛在的風險敞口會隨時間逐步遞減。
Fitch Ratings 信用分析師 Anubhav Arora 則坦言，評等機構之所以願意給這些資料中心專案投資等級評等，「高度仰賴 Google 提供的擔保」作為信用支撐。
他預期這股趨勢短期內不會停歇，畢竟 Google 過去十二個月的營運現金流超過 1850 億美元，融資實力仍相當雄厚。

資產負債表大變身：從「零負債」神話到近千億美元舉債

Alphabet 長年給外界的印象，是現金水位極高、幾乎不需要靠負債擴張的穩健企業。然而，這樣的形象正快速瓦解。
截至六月底，Alphabet 的債務規模已從一年前的 236 億美元，暴增至 980 億美元；公司並在二十多年來首次發行新股籌資。上季財報更顯示，Alphabet 作為上市公司，史上首度出現自由現金流為負的季度。
除了已生效的 438 億美元擔保外，Alphabet 另外還簽下總額 852 億美元、尚未正式啟動的表外資料中心租賃合約；為協助合作夥伴取得電力與能源設備，又額外提供了 76 億美元的後備擔保，並已承諾在條款拍板後，再追加 241 億美元的未來擔保額度。
分析人士指出，這股靠表外工具支撐 AI 建設的風潮並非 Google 獨有。Meta(META-US) 透過在路易斯安那州、德州成立少數股權合資企業，把資料中心建設成本移出自家資產負債表。
此外，甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 同樣仰賴類似的表外安排來支應擴張野心。AI 基礎設施的燒錢速度，正迫使科技巨頭們一齊向華爾街的融資手法靠攏。

提供擔保也要分一杯羹：認股權證鎖住上檔獲利

有趣的是，Google 在承擔下檔風險的同時，也沒忘記為自己爭取上檔利益。
在部分交易中，Google 會以提供擔保為條件，向資料中心開發商換取股權認股權證。換言之，若這些公司股價表現亮眼，Google 也能跟著受惠。
例如，在紐約州巴克為 Fluidstack 興建資料中心的 TeraWulf，Google 握有的認股權證相當於該公司 14% 股權；在與 Cipher Digital 的合作案中，Google 也取得價值相當於 5.4% 股權的認股權證。
一旦 Google 選擇提前終止擔保，雖然可能得向債券持有人支付一大筆一次性費用，但這筆錢實質上會轉化為對該專案的所有權權益。
不過並非所有交易都如此對等。以 Hut 8 的合作案為例，Fitch Ratings 指出，若 Fluidstack 違約，Google 必須概括承受長達十五年租期的全部付款義務，而且一旦工程出現重大延誤，雙方都無法片面解除合約。
更特別的是，Google 在這筆交易中並未取得任何認股權證。Hut 8 執行長 Asher Genoot 在財報電話會議上透露，這筆資料中心租約總價值達 70 億美元，另加約 20 億美元的電力與財產稅保險等費用。
知情人士表示，這筆交易條件特殊，外界普遍認為未來不太可能複製。
paras_en: As the AI arms race heats up, Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Google’s parent, is quietly tapping Wall Street’s financial engineering, using a technique rarely seen at tech giants: massive off‑balance‑sheet guarantees to pave the way for its own AI chips.

According to Alphabet’s latest disclosed financials, the potential default guarantees it provides to data‑center tenants have a "nominal amount" that jumped from $6.5 billion at the end of September last year to nearly six times that, reaching $43.8 billion.
That means, if a guaranteed party runs into financial trouble, Google could be on the hook for payments in the hundreds of billions of dollars in a worst‑case scenario.
Using Guarantees to Gain Market Share: TPU’s Alternative Path Against Nvidia
The wave of guarantees, reported by The Information, is driven by Google’s ambition to push its own Tensor Processing Units (TPUs).
Compared with Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) AI chips, TPUs need developers to obtain financing at lower cost in order to win more data‑centers and customers such as Anthropic.
Google’s financial guarantees give those data‑center developers a credit endorsement, making it easier for them to borrow cheap money and speed up facility construction.
In other words, Google is using its balance sheet as a bargaining chip to expand TPU market reach.

Insiders told the media that internal assessments show future TPU‑related revenue will far outweigh any financial burden from the guarantees, and senior management is very confident about the accounting line.

So far Google has provided guarantees for about ten data‑center projects covering roughly 2.4 GW of power capacity, but because the projects are not yet completed, the guarantees have not been triggered.

These deals typically follow a triangular structure: the cloud‑startup Fluidstack leases and plans the data center, installs TPUs inside, and then sub‑leases compute capacity to end users such as Anthropic.
Companies that originally mined cryptocurrency, such as Hut 8 (HUT-US) and TeraWulf (WULF-US), have pivoted to AI infrastructure and often act as the actual operators of the data centers.
The headline figure of $43.8 billion looks alarming, but the fair‑value amount recorded on Alphabet’s balance sheet is only $815 million.

The "nominal value" reflects the maximum possible loss in an extreme scenario, whereas fair value is the expected outflow Google estimates based on default probability, timing and recoverable amounts.
Credit‑rating firm CreditSights’ technical research head Jordan Chalfin says the market need not overreact to the nominal number because multiple mechanisms mitigate risk.

For example, if a tenant defaults, Google usually has the right to take over the underlying lease, use the space itself or re‑lease it to another customer, effectively acquiring scarce compute capacity; many leases run up to fifteen years, so exposure diminishes over time.

Fitch Ratings analyst Anubhav Arora notes that rating agencies are willing to give these data‑center projects investment‑grade ratings largely because of the “highly relied‑upon” guarantees from Google.
He expects the trend to continue in the short term, given Alphabet’s operating cash flow of over $185 billion in the past twelve months, which shows strong financing capacity.
Balance‑Sheet Transformation: From a "Zero‑Debt" Myth to Nearly $100 Billion of Borrowing
Alphabet has long cultivated an image of a cash‑rich, virtually debt‑free, ultra‑stable company, but that perception is rapidly eroding.

As of the end of June, Alphabet’s debt rose from $23.6 billion a year ago to $98 billion, and the company issued new equity for the first time in more than two decades. Its most recent quarterly report even showed a negative free‑cash‑flow quarter for the first time in history.

In addition to the $43.8 billion of guarantees already in effect, Alphabet has signed off‑balance‑sheet data‑center lease contracts totaling $85.2 billion that have not yet been activated; it also provided a $7.6 billion backup guarantee to help partners secure power and equipment, and has pledged an additional $24.1 billion of future guarantees once the terms are finalized.

Analysts point out that this wave of off‑balance‑sheet tools to fund AI builds is not unique to Google. Meta (META-US) has created minority‑equity joint ventures in Louisiana and Texas to move data‑center construction costs off its own balance sheet.

Oracle (ORCL-US) similarly relies on comparable off‑balance‑sheet arrangements to fund its expansion ambitions. The cash‑burn rate of AI infrastructure is pushing the tech giants toward Wall Street‑style financing.
Guarantees Also Earn a Slice of the Upside: Warrants Lock In Potential Gains
Interestingly, while Google assumes downside risk, it also secures upside upside by extracting equity‑linked warrants in some transactions.
In certain deals, Google provides guarantees in exchange for stock warrants from the data‑center developers. If those companies’ shares perform well, Google benefits as well.

For example, in the TeraWulf data‑center that Fluidstack is building in Buck, New York, Google holds warrants equivalent to 14 % of the company’s equity; in its partnership with Cipher Digital, Google obtained warrants representing roughly 5.4 % of the equity.
If Google chooses to terminate a guarantee early, it may have to pay a large one‑time fee to bondholders, but that payment effectively converts into an ownership stake in the project.

However, not all transactions are structured that way. In the Hut 8 deal, Fitch Ratings notes that if Fluidstack defaults, Google would have to assume the full payment obligations for the entire fifteen‑year lease, and any major construction delay would prevent either party from unilaterally walking away.

Moreover, Google did not receive any warrants in that particular transaction. Hut 8 CEO Asher Genoot told the earnings call that the data‑center lease is valued at $7 billion, plus roughly $2 billion in power, property‑tax and insurance costs.
Insiders say the terms of that deal are unique and unlikely to be replicated elsewhere.

items.title: 美AI股反彈動能本周迎「硬門檻」！華爾街估7月非農就業新增8.5萬人 Kalshi押7萬區間
items.title_en: US AI Stocks Face "Hard Threshold" This Week as Wall Street Expects 850,000 July Non-Farm Payroll Additions
paras: 美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 本週五 (7 日) 將公布 7 月非農就業新增人數，道瓊斯經濟學家一致預期新增 8.5 萬人、失業率 4.3%，《路透社》調查中位數落在 8.3-8.5 萬人，巴克莱等樂觀派看 10 萬，相較於 6 月僅增 5.7 萬、失業率 4.2%，市場實質押注「低成長但未失速」的溫和放緩。
對全球股票多頭、尤其半導體與 AI 算力鏈而言，週五數據是 7 月底暴力反彈後第一道硬門檻。6 月非農就業人數爆冷至僅新增 5.7 萬人後，「升息預期降溫」讓那指與費半指數獲得喘息機會。
最理想情境是新增 7 萬至 10 萬人、失業率穩在 4.2% 至 4.3%、薪資續降的「金髮姑娘」組合，既證明消費與企業獲利未滑向衰退，又不逼聯準會 (Fed) 強化升息路徑，壓低實質利率與折現率，這對長期、估值敏感的 HBM、網通與 AI 應用股屬於利多。
但付費預測市場搶跑華爾街。Kalshi 與 Polymarket 真金白銀押注者認為，7 月新增逾 8 萬人機率僅 47%、超 7 萬人約 60%、達 9 萬人約 41%、破 10 萬人略高於三分之一，不到 6 萬人機率約三分之一。
Kalshi 上月曾押注 6 月超 12.5 萬機率 63%，結果最終 5.7 萬，預測盤同樣看走眼。
不過，若新增破 10 萬人且薪資增幅重新加速，聯準會 9 月升息機率 (當前約 64% 至 68%) 與長債殖利率回彈，30 年期美債曾觸 5.24% 至 5.27%，高估值 AI 股吃不下第二輪利率衝擊。
若低於 6 萬人且失業率彈升、工時萎縮，債市初步上漲後邏輯會切至「獲利衰退」，週期、金融、出口鏈將先受到影響。
油價周一 (3 日) 收跌約 5%、美債殖利率回落帶動標普 500 指數收漲 1.48%、那指漲 2.13%，多頭依賴的正是「油價降＋利率降＋科技獲利韌性」三大利多共振。
專家指出，非農數據不是單一利多，而是把 7 月槓桿強平後的技術修復，升格為新一輪風險偏好上行、或是打回高波動回補的分水嶺。
paras_en: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is set to release the July non-farm payroll additions on Friday, with Wall Street economists unanimously expecting an addition of 850,000 jobs and a 4.3% unemployment rate. A Reuters survey puts the median estimate at 830,000 to 850,000, while Barclays and other optimistic analysts predict 1 million additions, compared to the 570,000 additions in June and a 4.2% unemployment rate. The market is essentially betting on a "soft landing" with moderate growth but no slowdown.

For global stock bulls, particularly those in the semiconductor and AI computing chains, Friday's data will be the first "hard threshold" since the violent rebound at the end of July. After the June non-farm payroll additions came in at a disappointing 570,000, "dovish" expectations of interest rate hikes gave the Nasdaq and the Philly Fed Index a breather.

The ideal scenario would be an addition of 700,000 to 1 million jobs, a stable unemployment rate of 4.2% to 4.3%, and a decline in wages, which would prove that consumption and corporate profits have not yet slid into a recession, while also not forcing the Federal Reserve (Fed) to strengthen its interest rate hike path, thereby lowering the effective interest rate and discount rate. This would be a positive for long-term, value-sensitive stocks in HBM, telecom, and AI applications.

However, paid prediction markets are beating Wall Street to the punch. Kalshi and Polymarket's silver-tongued bettors believe that the probability of adding over 800,000 jobs is only 47%, while exceeding 700,000 jobs is around 60%, reaching 900,000 jobs is approximately 41%, and breaking 1 million jobs is slightly above one-third. The probability of adding less than 600,000 jobs is around one-third.
Kalshi had previously bet on a 63% probability of exceeding 12.5 million jobs in June, but the actual number came in at 570,000, with the prediction market also looking over-optimistic.

However, if the additions exceed 1 million and wages growth accelerates, the Fed's interest rate hike probability in September (currently around 64% to 68%) and the long-term bond yield will rebound, with the 30-year US Treasury yield touching 5.24% to 5.27%, which would be a second-round shock for high-valued AI stocks.

If the additions are below 600,000 and the unemployment rate rises, with hours worked declining, the bond market will initially rally before logic shifts to "profit decline," with cyclicals, financials, and export chains being the first to be affected.

Oil prices fell by around 5% on Monday, with the 10-year Treasury yield decline driving the S&P 500 index up 1.48% and the Nasdaq up 2.13%, with bulls relying on the "oil price down + interest rate down + tech profit resilience" triple bullish synergy.

Experts point out that non-farm payroll data is not a single bullish factor, but rather a technical repair of the July 7th strong flattening, which has been upgraded to a new round of risk-on, or a dividing line for high volatility to rebound.

items.title: 俄羅斯警告愛爾蘭：這是海盜行為！後果很嚴重
items.title_en: Russia Warns Ireland: This is Piracy! Consequences are Severe
paras: 據《塔斯社》3 日（周一）報導，俄羅斯駐愛爾蘭大使尤里 · 菲拉托夫（Yury Filatov）表示，俄方已向愛爾蘭發出警告，如果都柏林以涉嫌違反對俄制裁為由，對商船採取「海盜行徑」， 將引發嚴重後果。
愛爾蘭近期通過的法律規定，愛爾蘭軍隊可以「打擊違反對俄制裁行為」為由登船檢查。
據英國《衛報》3 日報導，近幾周愛爾蘭官員發現，越來越多俄羅斯「影子艦隊」船隻正穿行北大西洋愛爾蘭附近水域，以繞開管控升級的英國和法國水域。
長期以來，西方國家指控俄羅斯利用油輪等商用船隻逃避西方制裁，將這些商用船隻稱為「影子艦隊」。除俄羅斯外，委內瑞拉、伊朗也被指控利用此類船隊出口石油。
歐盟已通過一批對俄制裁方案，包括對俄羅斯「影子艦隊」船隻實施制裁，禁止其停靠歐盟港口，並停止提供相關海事服務。
義大利國防部 8 月 2 日稱，在地中海執行歐盟長期軍事行動的義大利海軍，當天攔截一艘受制裁的俄羅斯「影子艦隊」油輪。這是歐盟近兩周來第二次此類攔查行動。
英國和法國均已表示，將阻截任何途經領海、與俄羅斯受制裁「影子艦隊」有關的船隻。英國政府於今年 3 月宣布，已授權軍方檢查「影子艦隊」船隻。
英國前首相施凱爾 6 月 14 日證實，武裝部隊當天凌晨在英吉利海峽攔截一艘俄羅斯「影子艦隊」船隻。
英國國防部則稱，在一項六小時行動中，英國皇家海軍陸戰隊突擊隊員與國家打擊犯罪局受過專門訓練的執法人員，登上了這艘受制裁油輪，這是英方首次主導此類行動。
paras_en: Russia's Ambassador to Ireland, Yury Filatov, stated that Russia has issued a warning to Ireland, saying that if Dublin takes 'pirate-like' measures against commercial ships suspected of violating sanctions against Russia, it will have severe consequences.
Ireland recently passed a law allowing its military to board and inspect ships for violating sanctions against Russia.

According to a report by The Guardian, Irish officials have discovered that an increasing number of Russian 'shadow fleet' ships are sailing through the North Atlantic near Ireland, avoiding the upgraded controls of the UK and France.

Western countries have long accused Russia of using oil tankers and other commercial ships to evade sanctions, referring to these ships as the 'shadow fleet'. Venezuela and Iran have also been accused of using similar ship fleets to export oil.
The EU has implemented a series of sanctions against Russia, including a ban on Russian 'shadow fleet' ships docking at EU ports and providing related maritime services.

The Italian Ministry of Defense reported on August 2 that the Italian Navy, which is executing a long-term EU military operation in the Mediterranean, intercepted a Russian 'shadow fleet' oil tanker that was subject to sanctions. This was the second such interception by the EU in the past two weeks.

The UK and France have both stated that they will intercept any ships passing through their territorial waters that are related to Russia's sanctioned 'shadow fleet'. The UK government announced in March that it had authorized the military to inspect 'shadow fleet' ships.
Former UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak confirmed on June 14 that British forces had intercepted a Russian 'shadow fleet' ship in the English Channel.

The UK Ministry of Defense stated that in a six-hour operation, British Royal Marines and specially trained law enforcement officers from the National Crime Agency boarded the sanctioned oil tanker, marking the first time the UK has led such an operation.

items.title: 蘋果20週年大改版！iPhone 20傳採玻璃超薄機身 散熱再升級
items.title_en: Apple 20th Anniversary iPhone 20 Rumored to Feature Glass Body and Improved Cooling
paras: 蘋果傳出計畫在 2027 年底推出 iPhone 問世 20 週年紀念機型，市場暫稱「iPhone 20」。最新消息指出，這款新機可能大量採用玻璃材質，並借鑑 iPhone Air 的超薄設計，同時擴大機身內部的散熱空間，以兼顧輕薄外型與效能表現。
微博爆料帳號「定焦數碼」近日表示，iPhone 20 的機身將以玻璃為主要材料，中框設計則可能接近 iPhone Air，整體厚度也有望維持在相近水準。
過去相關傳聞曾指出，蘋果可能為這款紀念機導入大面積曲面玻璃及固態按鍵，進一步減少傳統機械結構，打造更一體化的外觀。
這並非「定焦數碼」首次將 iPhone 20 與 iPhone Air 相提並論。該帳號 7 月便曾透露，蘋果準備讓週年紀念機型「回歸玻璃」，部分零組件可能沿用第一代 iPhone Air 採用的加工方式。
除了外觀變化，iPhone 20 的散熱能力也可能升級。
「定焦數碼」聲稱，新機內部的散熱板將擴大約「1 吋」，暗示蘋果可能為這款超薄機型配置面積更大的導熱結構，藉此提升長時間執行高負載工作的穩定性。
目前尚無法確定 iPhone 20 是否會直接採用均熱板散熱。
iPhone 17 Pro 系列已導入均熱板技術，可將 A19 Pro 晶片產生的熱量快速分散至機身其他區域；定位更輕薄的 iPhone Air 則未採用相同方案。
考量超薄機身通常更難處理熱量，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 若要進一步提升紀念機型的性能，導入均熱板具有一定合理性。
同一爆料來源先前也曾宣稱，折疊式 iPhone 將配置多組均熱板。不過，所謂散熱板面積增加，也可能只是代表蘋果擴大傳統導熱材料，而非確定採用均熱板。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週一 (3 日) 下滑約 1.8%，收在 303.42 美元，連續第四個交易日收黑，由於 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 市值超越蘋果，使蘋果跌至全美市值第三大企業。
paras_en: Apple is reportedly planning to release a 20th-anniversary iPhone model, dubbed 'iPhone 20,' in late 2027. According to the latest rumors, this new device may feature a glass body and adopt the ultra-thin design of the iPhone Air, while also expanding the internal cooling space to balance the lightweight exterior and performance.

A Weibo account called '定焦數碼' (Ding Jiao Shu Mu) recently claimed that the iPhone 20's body will be made of glass, with a middle frame design similar to the iPhone Air, and a thickness that may be similar to the Air.

Previous rumors suggested that Apple might introduce large-area curved glass and solid-state buttons for this commemorative model, further reducing traditional mechanical structures and creating a more integrated appearance.

This is not the first time '定焦數碼' has compared the iPhone 20 to the iPhone Air. The account revealed in July that Apple plans to let the anniversary model 'return to glass,' with some components possibly using the same processing method as the first-generation iPhone Air.
In addition to the exterior changes, the iPhone 20's cooling capabilities may also be upgraded.

'定焦數碼' claims that the new device's heat sink will be expanded by about '1 inch,' implying that Apple may equip this ultra-thin model with a larger heat-dissipation structure to improve stability during long periods of high-load work.
It is currently unclear whether the iPhone 20 will directly adopt the uniform heat plate cooling system.

The iPhone 17 Pro series has already introduced uniform heat plate technology, which quickly disperses heat generated by the A19 Pro chip to other areas of the device; in contrast, the thinner iPhone Air does not use the same scheme.

Considering that ultra-thin devices often have difficulty handling heat, Apple (AAPL-US) may have a rational reason to introduce uniform heat plates to further improve the performance of the commemorative model.

The same leak source previously claimed that the foldable iPhone would be equipped with multiple uniform heat plates. However, the increased heat sink area may simply represent Apple expanding traditional heat-dissipation materials rather than adopting uniform heat plates.

Apple (AAPL-US) fell by about 1.8% on Monday (3rd) to close at $303.42, marking its fourth consecutive trading day in the red. As Alphabet (GOOGL-US) surpassed Apple in market value, Apple dropped to the third-largest company in the US by market value.

items.title: 輝達卡關200美元區間 科技巨頭財報也未能助突破
items.title_en: Nvidia Stuck in $200 Range, Tech Giants' Earnings Also Fail to Break Through
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 股價周一 (3 日) 收高，扭轉盤中早些時候跌勢。不過，這家晶片大廠的股價似乎仍需要一份亮眼的財報，才能真正擺脫目前的盤整格局。
輝達股價終場上漲 2.9%，收在 206.64 美元，盤中一度漲至 208.74 美元。但過去三個月來，股價大致呈現橫盤整理，累計僅上漲 1.1%。
截至目前，本季財報季尚未為輝達帶來明顯催化劑。雖然多家科技巨頭陸續上調資本支出預測，但市場開始質疑，輝達是否仍會是最大受惠者，因記憶體晶片等其他 AI 硬體成本持續攀升，可能分食原本流向 GPU 的投資預算。
更大的問題在於，整體 AI 投資熱潮正受到借貸成本上升的影響而出現降溫跡象，使輝達股價難以持續突破。
此外，輝達近期透過資產負債表向 AI 新創企業提供融資的做法——《巴隆》形容其如「同時扮演創投與中央銀行」——也引發市場質疑。
21Shares 宏觀經濟研究主管 Stephen Coltman 在報告中表示，「許多過去現金流極為充沛的企業，如今為了投資 AI 基礎設施，不得不大舉舉債。即使是獲利能力最高、市值最大的輝達，也因傳出向客戶提供數千億美元規模的供應商融資與信用擔保，導致其信用利差擴大。」
不過，市場仍期待輝達將於 8 月 26 日公布的財報，有望成為股價突破盤整的重要催化劑，前提是投資人認為目前股價已具備足夠吸引力。
根據 FactSet，目前華爾街分析師對輝達的平均目標價為 314.29 美元。
今年以來，輝達股價累計上漲 10.8%，若以過去 12 個月計算，漲幅則達 14.8%。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares closed higher on Monday (the 3rd), reversing an earlier intraday decline. However, the chip maker still seems to need a standout earnings report to truly escape its current consolidation pattern.
Nvidia’s stock finished up 2.9% at $206.64, having peaked intraday at $208.74. Over the past three months the stock has essentially moved sideways, gaining only 1.1% in total.

So far this earnings season has not provided a clear catalyst for Nvidia. Although several tech giants have been raising their capital‑expenditure forecasts, the market is beginning to question whether Nvidia will remain the biggest beneficiary, as costs for other AI hardware such as memory chips continue to rise and could eat into the budget that would otherwise go to GPUs.
A bigger issue is that the overall AI investment boom is showing signs of cooling as borrowing costs rise, making it harder for Nvidia’s share price to sustain a breakout.

In addition, Nvidia’s recent practice of providing financing to AI startups through its balance sheet—described by Baron as “playing both venture capitalist and central bank”—has also drawn market skepticism.

Stephen Coltman, head of macro‑economic research at 21Shares, said in a report, “Many companies that once had abundant cash flow now have to take on large debt to invest in AI infrastructure. Even the most profitable and largest‑by‑market‑cap company, Nvidia, has seen its credit spread widen after reports that it is offering supplier financing and credit guarantees to customers worth hundreds of billions of dollars.”

Nevertheless, the market still hopes that Nvidia’s earnings report due on August 26 will serve as a key catalyst for breaking out of the range, provided investors deem the current price sufficiently attractive.
According to FactSet, Wall Street analysts currently have an average target price of $314.29 for Nvidia.
So far this year Nvidia’s stock has risen 10.8%, and over the past 12 months it has gained 14.8%.

items.title: 《大賣空》貝瑞警告美股恐「一片狼藉」！點「這一」被忽視潛在風險
items.title_en: Michael Burry Warns of Potential Risk in US Stock Market
paras: 《大賣空》原型、著名投資人貝瑞（Michael Burry），近日在其 Substack 平台發文警告，美股市場恐面臨一場多數投資人未曾留意的潛在風險，即由波動率交易策略基金所觸發的自動化拋售連鎖反應，可能導致股市急速崩跌。
根據《Business Insider》報導，貝瑞指出，一旦這類拋售潮爆發，恐讓相關持股陷入「大屠殺」的局面。
他以近期動能股的重挫為例，說明了這種情況可能如何發生。所謂動能股，指的是股價曾快速飆升的個股；隨著投資人近幾週獲利了結，並將資金自漲勢凌厲的記憶體與晶片類股中撤出，動能股跌勢明顯。
追蹤此類股票的安碩 MSCI 美國動能因子 ETF(MTUM-US) ，已較近期高點下挫達 14%。
貝瑞在文中警告：「這將留下一片血腥狼藉，但多數人根本沒料到會發生這種事。」
他認為，華爾街以波動率為核心的自動化交易基金，正成為當前市場的一大問題，因為如今的市場波動程度已較過去明顯升高。
貝瑞特別提到，股市在下跌時的反應似乎變得格外劇烈。所謂市場的「額外恐慌」指標，即市場在下跌日呈現出「不成比例的過度反應」，目前已攀升至 98 年來的最高水準。
不過，另一方面，市場在經歷劇烈拋售後，反彈速度也比過去快得多。貝瑞認為，這顯示市場波動很大一部分是由自動化交易程式所推動。
他寫道：「數據顯示，如今的投資人相較於過去，更容易因較小的虧損而感到不安，更傾向於在盤中逢低買進，也更可能經歷劇烈的市場混亂。」
貝瑞強調，沒有任何「真人」投資人會以這種方式運作。換句話說，他認為，現在市場的行為，已經不像真人投資人在交易，而是越來越像演算法或自動化交易程式在主導。
貝瑞進一步描繪了幾種可能情境，說明在部分基金高度槓桿操作下，以波動率為核心策略的基金如何可能引發股市大幅且突如其來的回檔。
他舉例指出，若標普 500 指數僅出現約 2.5% 的溫和跌幅，波動率策略基金便可能將股票曝險比重，從資產的 77% 降至約 50%，凸顯市場下行風險可能被大幅放大。
根據貝瑞針對標普 500 指數期貨合約的分析，目前以波動率為操作依據的基金，管理資產規模約達 5,000 億美元。
相較於規模高達 60 兆美元的美國整體股市，這個數字看似微不足道，但貝瑞警告，若這些自動化交易程式的拋售在同一時間集中爆發，仍足以對市場造成顯著衝擊。
他並表示，若一向有助於維持市場穩定的被動型投資人也開始跟進賣股，跌勢恐將進一步惡化。
談及波動率策略基金可能集中平倉的情況時，貝瑞寫道：「這將是一股極為龐大的力量，並向市場釋放各種動能，進一步被其他市場參與者放大。」
他接著表示，這波賣壓可能觸發大量停損單或風險管理機制，加劇市場下跌；不過，依據本十年以來的歷史經驗，市場最終仍將「比過去更快」恢復。
近來持續看空晶片股與 AI 概念股的貝瑞，多次警告本輪牛市累積的風險正逐步升高，尤其是在愈來愈多投資人開始質疑 AI 投資熱潮能否持續之際。
他近期也點名，美國私人信貸市場潛藏風險，同時警告 AI 產業中存在循環式交易現象，尤其是與輝達 (NVDA-US) 相關的交易結構，可能成為市場隱憂。
paras_en: Michael Burry, the legendary investor and prototype of "The Big Short", has recently warned on his Substack platform that the US stock market may face a potential risk that many investors have not noticed, triggered by the automated selling of volatility trading strategy funds, which could lead to a rapid collapse of the stock market.
According to a report by Business Insider, Burry pointed out that once this selling tide breaks out, it may put related stocks in a "bloodbath" situation.

He cited the recent decline of momentum stocks as an example, explaining how this situation could occur. Momentum stocks refer to stocks that have seen rapid price increases; as investors have taken profits in recent weeks and withdrawn funds from memory and chip stocks with strong momentum, momentum stocks have shown a clear decline.
The iShares MSCI USA Momentum Factor ETF (MTUM-US), which tracks these stocks, has fallen by 14% from its recent high.
Burry warned in his article: "This will leave a bloody mess, but most people don't think it will happen."

He believes that Wall Street's automated trading funds based on volatility are becoming a major problem in the current market, as the market's volatility has increased significantly compared to the past.

Burry particularly pointed out that the market's reaction to declines seems to have become extremely intense. The "excess panic" indicator, which shows the market's disproportionate overreaction on down days, has risen to its highest level in 98 years.

On the other hand, after experiencing intense selling, the market's rebound speed is much faster than in the past. Burry believes that this shows that a large part of the market's volatility is driven by automated trading programs.

He wrote: "The data shows that today's investors are more likely to feel uneasy about smaller losses than in the past, more likely to buy on dips during trading, and more likely to experience intense market chaos."

Burry emphasized that no "real" investor would operate in this way. In other words, he believes that the market's behavior is no longer like that of real investors trading, but is increasingly like algorithms or automated trading programs dominating.
Burry further depicted several possible scenarios, explaining how funds with high leverage and volatility-based strategies could trigger a sharp and sudden market correction.

He cited the example that if the S&P 500 index only experiences a mild decline of about 2.5%, volatility strategy funds may reduce their stock exposure from 77% of assets to around 50%, highlighting that the market's downside risk may be greatly amplified.
According to Burry's analysis of S&P 500 index futures contracts, funds operating based on volatility currently manage assets of around $500 billion.

Compared to the $60 trillion US stock market, this number seems insignificant, but Burry warned that if the automated trading programs' selling is concentrated at the same time, it could still have a significant impact on the market.
He also stated that if passive investors, who have always helped maintain market stability, start to follow suit and sell stocks, the decline may worsen.

When discussing the possibility of volatility strategy funds concentrated liquidation, Burry wrote: "This will be a very powerful force, releasing various energies into the market, which will be further amplified by other market participants."

He added that this selling pressure may trigger a large number of stop-loss orders or risk management mechanisms, exacerbating the market decline; however, based on historical experience over the past decade, the market will eventually "recover faster than in the past".

Burry, who has been bearish on chip stocks and AI concept stocks, has repeatedly warned that the risks accumulated in this bull market are gradually increasing, especially as more investors begin to question whether the AI investment boom can be sustained.

He has also pointed out that the US private credit market has hidden risks and warned of the existence of circular trading in the AI industry, particularly in transactions related to NVIDIA (NVDA-US), which could become a market concern.

items.title: 槓桿ETF規模逼近2500億美元！華爾街玩起「崩盤期權」 年化報酬率最高20%
items.title_en: Banks Turn to "Crash Puts" as Leveraged ETFs Approach $250 Billion
paras: 隨著全球槓桿 ETF 市場快速擴張，為其提供互換與槓桿支持的大型銀行，正日益倚重一類特殊場外衍生品「崩盤期權」（Crash Put），以轉移極端行情下可能面臨的尾部風險。
據彭博報導，高盛、巴克萊、花旗及法國巴黎銀行等大型投行均已積極布局這一市場。隨著槓桿 ETF 資產規模持續攀升，相關衍生品需求明顯升溫，其中高盛更向機構客戶推介相關交易，預期年化報酬率最高可達 14% 至 20%，吸引愈來愈多對沖基金與資產管理機構成為市場中的「保險提供者」。
所謂「崩盤期權」，本質上是一種為銀行提供尾部風險保障的場外衍生品，其出現與槓桿 ETF 本身存在的「缺口風險」（Gap Risk）有關。
以 2 倍槓桿 ETF 為例，若標的股票單日跌幅超過約 50%，基金淨值可能接近歸零，而作為互換交易對手的銀行，可能無法從 ETF 發行方收回全部損失。
在此情況下，銀行透過購買崩盤期權，提前將極端行情造成的損失轉移給外部投資者。當標的資產出現超預期暴跌時，由期權買方承擔相應風險，銀行則藉此降低自身曝險。
Kairos Investment Advisors 創辦人兼首席投資官 Ramon Verastegui 表示，這類交易本質上是一種高效率的「背靠背」風險轉移工具；Asym Research 創辦人 Rocky Fishman 則形容，其收益模式類似高收益債券，投資者持續獲取收益，但必須承擔極端事件發生時的損失。
崩盤期權需求快速升溫，背後原因在於槓桿 ETF 市場近年爆發式成長。彭博數據顯示，目前全球槓桿 ETF 資產規模已逼近 2500 億美元，美國市場更有超過 700 檔產品。雖然美國槓桿 ETF 管理規模在 6 月一度達到約 2000 億美元後回落至約 1600 億美元，但整體仍維持歷史高檔。
其中，SK 海力士 (000660KS) 、美光科技 (MU-US) 、輝達 (NVDA-US) 、特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 等高波動個股，已成為槓桿 ETF 熱門追蹤標的。Fishman 指出，部分 2 倍槓桿單股 ETF 所對應股票的波動率，甚至達到納斯達克 100 指數的 3 至 5 倍，使銀行管理相關產品的尾部風險難度高於 3 倍槓桿指數 ETF。
高收益也進一步推升機構投資者承接風險的意願。法國巴黎銀行推介資料顯示，今年 5 月，一筆針對 SK 海力士、履約價為股價 55%、期限最長 6 個月的單日缺口看跌期權，保費達 6.5%，三星電子相關產品保費也達 5.5%，高於今年 3 月時的 3.5% 與 2%。
同期，高盛向客戶推介的相關交易，在使用槓桿後，預期年化收益率可達 14.2% 至 20%。Janus Henderson 另類投資團隊組合經理 Natasha Sibley 表示，目前市場對這類產品的需求處於極高水準，銀行希望將風險轉移出去，而持續提高的收益率則吸引更多投資者提供避險資金。
不過，市場人士也警告，崩盤期權並非消除風險，而只是重新分配風險。由於相關產品主要透過場外交易完成，資訊透明度有限，市場難以精準掌握整體風險曝險。
Acadian Asset Management 組合經理 Owen Lamont 指出，歷史經驗顯示，槓桿、多重交易對手以及複雜金融創新的結合，往往可能放大金融市場的系統性風險。
隨著槓桿 ETF 持續擴張，圍繞其形成的互換交易與崩盤期權市場也將同步壯大。這類金融工具究竟能有效分散風險，或是在極端行情中成為放大市場衝擊的來源，已成為監管機構與市場參與者密切關注的議題。
paras_en: Banks are increasingly relying on a type of exotic derivative known as "crash puts" to mitigate the risks associated with leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) as the global market for these products continues to grow.

According to a report by Bloomberg, major banks such as Goldman Sachs, Barclays, JPMorgan Chase, and BNP Paribas have been actively building out their presence in this market. As the assets under management in leveraged ETFs continue to rise, the demand for these derivatives has also increased, with Goldman Sachs even offering them to institutional clients with expected annual returns of 14% to 20%.

The so-called "crash puts" are essentially a type of over-the-counter derivative that provides banks with protection against the risks associated with leveraged ETFs, particularly the "gap risk" that arises when the underlying stock price falls by more than 50% in a single day.

For example, if a 2x leveraged ETF is tracking a stock that falls by more than 50% in a day, the fund's net asset value could approach zero, leaving the bank that is acting as the counterparty to the trade with significant losses.

In this scenario, the bank can purchase a crash put to transfer the risk of extreme market movements to external investors. When the underlying asset experiences an unexpected decline, the buyer of the put option bears the corresponding risk, while the bank reduces its exposure.

Kairos Investment Advisors founder and chief investment officer Ramon Verastegui described this type of trade as a high-efficiency "back-to-back" risk transfer tool, while Asym Research founder Rocky Fishman compared its return profile to that of high-yield bonds, where investors receive continuous returns but must bear the risk of losses in extreme events.

The demand for crash puts has been rising rapidly, driven by the explosive growth of the leveraged ETF market. According to Bloomberg data, the global assets under management in leveraged ETFs have approached $250 billion, with over 700 products listed in the US market alone.

The US market for leveraged ETFs has seen a significant increase in assets under management, with a peak of around $200 billion in June, followed by a decline to around $160 billion in July. However, the overall level remains at historic highs.

Some of the most volatile stocks, such as SK Hynix (000660.KS), Micron Technology (MU.US), NVIDIA (NVDA.US), and Tesla (TSLA.US), have become popular tracking stocks for leveraged ETFs. Fishman noted that the volatility of some of these stocks is even higher than that of the Nasdaq 100 index, making it difficult for banks to manage the tail risk associated with these products.

The high returns offered by these products have also increased the willingness of institutional investors to take on risk. According to data from BNP Paribas, the premium for a single-day put option on SK Hynix with a strike price of 55% and a maturity of six months was 6.5% in May, while the premium for a similar option on Samsung Electronics was 5.5%, up from 3.5% and 2% in March.

Goldman Sachs has also been promoting similar trades to its clients, with expected annual returns of 14.2% to 20% after leverage. Janus Henderson's alternative investment team manager Natasha Sibley noted that the market demand for these products is at an all-time high, with banks seeking to transfer risk and investors attracted by the increasing returns.

However, market participants have warned that crash puts do not eliminate risk, but rather redistribute it. Since these products are primarily traded over-the-counter, transparency is limited, and the overall risk exposure is difficult to quantify.

Acadian Asset Management's portfolio manager Owen Lamont pointed out that historical experience has shown that the combination of leverage, multiple counterparties, and complex financial innovations can amplify systemic risk in financial markets.

As the leveraged ETF market continues to grow, the market for exchange-traded options and crash puts will likely expand in tandem. The effectiveness of these financial tools in diversifying risk or amplifying market shocks remains a closely watched issue by regulators and market participants.

items.title: 川普罕見列時間表 稱美國將在他任期結束前控制格陵蘭島
items.title_en: Trump Unusually Lists Timeline, Says U.S. Will Control Greenland Before His Term Ends
paras: 據美國《新聞周刊》和英國《獨立報》2 日（周日）報導，美國總統川普日前在接受採訪時表示，格陵蘭島將在他本屆總統任期結束、即 2029 年 1 月前由美國「控制」。
美國保守派媒體「真正美國之聲」節目主持人史蒂夫 · 格魯伯在 7 月 31 日的採訪中說：「我曾在這個節目中預測，在你卸任之前，格陵蘭島將處於我國實際控制之下。」
川普說道：「你會是對的…… 對我國來說，格陵蘭很重要。」
川普從 8 月 1 日至 2 日在 Truth Social 平台發布約 40 條帖子，其中部分為人工智慧（AI）技術生成的圖像。一張圖顯示巨大的川普俯瞰格陵蘭島，暗示他希望美國「控制」格陵蘭島。
《獨立報》提到，川普長期主張由美國奪取丹麥自治領地格陵蘭島的控制權，還曾說希望實現對格陵蘭島「完全、徹底的購買」，並為此威脅對丹麥等部分歐洲國家商品加徵關稅，以推動達成相關協議。
《新聞周刊》指出，美國官方聲稱推動「控制」格陵蘭島是出於國家安全考慮。目前美國已透過皮圖菲克太空基地在格陵蘭島維持軍事存在，通過該基地進行飛彈預警和太空監視等活動。
格陵蘭島擁有稀土礦藏，以及對現代科技和軍事供應鏈至關重要的其他關鍵礦產資源。
川普有關「控制」格陵蘭島的言論遭到格陵蘭島和丹麥反對。格陵蘭島自治政府總理延斯 - 弗雷德里克 · 尼爾森曾說：「格陵蘭島不出售。」
他強調，格陵蘭島「不會被美國擁有，不會由美國統治，也不會成為美國的一部分」。
丹麥首相梅特 · 弗雷德里克森也曾表示：「眾所周知，美國想要擁有、接管格陵蘭島，我希望全世界都知道，這不會發生。」
paras_en: According to U.S. Newsweek and the UK’s Independent on Sunday on Sunday, the 2nd, U.S. President Donald Trump recently said in an interview that Greenland will be "controlled" by the United States before his current presidential term ends in January 2029.

Steve Gruber, host of the conservative media program "Real America’s Voice," said in a July 31 interview, "I predicted on this show that before you leave office, Greenland will be under our actual control."
Trump added, "You would be right… Greenland is important to our country."

From August 1 to 2, Trump posted about 40 messages on the Truth Social platform, some of which included images generated by artificial‑intelligence technology. One image showed a gigantic Trump looking down on Greenland, implying his desire for the United States to "control" the island.

The Independent noted that Trump has long advocated for the United States to seize control of the Danish autonomous territory of Greenland, even saying he wants a "complete, thorough purchase" of the island and threatening to levy tariffs on goods from Denmark and other European countries to push a deal.

Newsweek pointed out that U.S. officials claim the push to "control" Greenland is driven by national‑security considerations. The United States already maintains a military presence on Greenland via the Pituffik Space Base, using the site for missile warning and space‑surveillance activities.
Greenland holds rare‑earth deposits and other critical mineral resources that are vital to modern technology and military supply chains.

Trump’s remarks about "controlling" Greenland have been met with opposition from Greenland and Denmark. Greenland’s autonomous government premier Jens‑Frederik Nielsen said, "Greenland is not for sale," emphasizing that Greenland "will not be owned by the United States, will not be ruled by the United States, and will not become part of the United States."
Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen also said, "It is well known that the United States wants to own and take over Greenland; I want the whole world to know that this will not happen."

items.title_en: Not About Protecting the Yen, It's About Bargaining! Experts: No Free Lunch—Washington’s “Friendship Signal” Hides Three Big Calculations
paras: 美國財政部上周五 (7 月 31 日) 協同日本財務省直接買入日元，為 1998 年來雙邊首見、2011 年後多邊框架外再度聯手護匯市，因日元兌美元匯率創近 40 年低，美國總統川普把行動包裝成「數十年來首次聯手捍衛日元的友誼信號」，財長貝森特稱「為值得信賴的夥伴提供支持」。
但華府智庫與市場幾乎一面倒質疑。國際金融協會 (IIF) 高級經濟學家 Jonathan Fortun Vargas 說：「天下沒有免費午餐，我們懂川普風格。」
大西洋理事會經濟前瞻與分析主任 Charles Lichfield 則點破核心，稱華府優先要務是在防止美債殖利率飆升，遠高於地緣作秀。
首先，日本是美債最大外國持有者，若東京為撐日元拋售美債換美元，31 兆美元美債市場將遭連鎖賣壓，10 年期美債殖利率上周五正好觸及美國財長貝森特上任以來最高。
貝森特周日 (2 日) 發文特意點出 FIMA Repo 機制，讓日本抵押美債換美元流動性、不必真拋持倉，等於把「救日元」與「穩美債」綁同一條船。
其次，華府要日本兌現 5500 億美元對美投資承諾，貿易談判再要讓步；日本下半年重訂國安優先順序，軍費加碼料成川普下一張牌。同時，日相高市早苗支持率滑落，華府護匯亦有鞏固同屬保守陣營領導人之意，套路類似去年對阿根廷。
最後，貝森特屢批日本央行 (BOJ) 抗通膨太慢，將在本月會見 BOJ 總裁植田和男。
瑞穗證券資深市場經濟學家 Yusuke Matsuo 指出，協調干預＋逼 BOJ 升息是同一套拳，目標是阻止日本國債殖利率暴衝外溢燒到美債，市場押注 BOJ 下月升息機率已逼近 50%、10 月約 90%。
截至周二 (4 日) 上午，日元仍穩居高於干預前水位，但「友誼」能撐多久，取決於 BOJ 何時升息、日相高市早苗會否再擴張財政及美債殖利率曲線是否會買單。
paras_en: On Friday, July 31, the U.S. Treasury, together with Japan’s Ministry of Finance, directly bought yen – the first bilateral joint intervention since 1998 and the first multilateral‑framework‑free cooperation since 2011 – to support the foreign‑exchange market as the yen‑dollar rate fell to a near‑40‑year low. President Trump framed the move as a “friendship signal” marking the first joint defense of the yen in decades, and Treasury Secretary Yellen said it was “support for a trustworthy partner.”

But think‑tanks and markets in Washington almost uniformly questioned the move. International Institute of Finance senior economist Jonathan Fortun Vargas said, “There’s no such thing as a free lunch; we understand Trump’s style.”
Atlantic Council senior economist Charles Lichfield cut to the core, stating that Washington’s top priority is preventing U.S. Treasury yields from spiking, far above any geopolitical showmanship.

First, Japan is the largest foreign holder of U.S. Treasuries. If Tokyo were to sell U.S. bonds for dollars to prop up the yen, the $31 trillion Treasury market would face a cascade of selling pressure, and 10‑year Treasury yields hit their highest level since Yellen took office last Friday.

Yellen’s Sunday (the 2nd) post specifically highlighted the FIMA Repo mechanism, which lets Japan pledge Treasuries for dollar liquidity without actually liquidating its holdings—effectively tying “saving the yen” to “stabilizing U.S. bonds” on the same boat.

Second, Washington wants Japan to fulfill its $550 billion investment commitment to the United States and to make further concessions in trade talks; Japan’s mid‑year reshuffle of national‑security priorities and a boost in defense spending are expected to become Trump’s next bargaining chip. At the same time, support for Prime Minister Kishida is slipping, and Washington’s currency support also serves to shore up a fellow conservative leader, a tactic similar to last year’s approach toward Argentina.
Finally, Yellen has repeatedly criticized the Bank of Japan for moving too slowly on inflation and is slated to meet BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda later this month.

Mizuho Securities senior market economist Yusuke Matsuo noted that coordinated intervention and pressuring the BOJ to raise rates are two sides of the same strategy, aimed at preventing Japanese government‑bond yields from spilling over and inflating U.S. Treasury yields. The market now sees the probability of a BOJ rate hike next month approaching 50 % and about 90 % for October.

As of Tuesday morning (the 4th), the yen remained above the level before the intervention, but how long the “friendship” can hold depends on when the BOJ raises rates, whether Prime Minister Kishida expands fiscal spending, and whether the Treasury‑yield curve will accommodate the move.

items.title: 華府智庫CSIS：川普屢次未兌現打擊威脅 讓伊朗認為美國很軟弱
items.title_en: CSIS: Trump's Repeated Failure to Follow Through on Threats Makes Iran See the U.S. as Weak
paras: 美國智庫「戰略與國際問題研究中心 (CSIS)」中東項目主任 Mona Yacoubian 周一(3 日) 警告，川普政府多次對伊朗放出「最嚴厲威脅」卻未在最後關頭兌現打擊行動，已讓德黑蘭解讀為「美國軟弱」，並自認在美伊衝突中佔據上風。
她說：「每次他這樣做，伊朗接收到的訊號就是：美國很軟弱，伊朗佔了上風。」
Yacoubian 也整理出當前的「軍事升級→宣布外交突破卻落空→重回相互威脅」的循環模式。
她認為，這種「狼來了」式的操作削弱華府威懾可信度，也讓伊朗更有底氣拖過選舉週期與彈藥消耗期。
Yacoubian 還指出，美國最近一次暫緩打擊，關鍵變數在波斯灣盟友——沙特、阿聯、卡達擔心伊朗會毫不猶豫報復區域基礎設施與能源樞紐，把霍爾木茲風險一次性引爆，因此向白宮施壓踩剎車。
分析指出，特朗普「極限施壓＋臨陣回縮」的談判術，用於商業博弈或尚可，但面對承受痛苦門檻更高的伊朗政體，反襯出華府軍事選項的政治成本：中期選舉將近、油價敏感、彈藥庫存下滑。伊朗則借機把「美國不敢打」內化為心理優勢，在核談判、海峽通行與代理人戰線上同步抬價。
市場與外交圈解讀，若威懾可信度持續流失，下階段風險不在「美國打多大」，而在「伊朗先手多狠」——從無人機騷擾到能源設施靶向攻擊，區域火藥味只會更濃。
paras_en: Mona Yacoubian, director of the Middle East program at the U.S. think tank Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), warned on Monday (the 3rd) that the Trump administration’s repeated issuance of "the harshest threats" toward Iran without actually carrying out strikes at the last moment has led Tehran to interpret this as "U.S. weakness" and to believe it holds the upper hand in any U.S.-Iran confrontation.
She said, "Every time he does this, the signal Iran receives is: the United States is weak, and Iran has the advantage."
Yacoubian also outlined the current cycle of "military escalation → announced diplomatic breakthrough that falls flat → back to mutual threats."
She believes this "boy‑who‑cried‑wolf" approach erodes the credibility of Washington’s deterrence and gives Iran more confidence to ride out an election cycle and a period of ammunition consumption.

Yacoubian further noted that the most recent U.S. pause on strikes was driven by concerns from Gulf allies—Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Qatar—that Iran might retaliate without hesitation against regional infrastructure and energy hubs, potentially igniting a one‑off crisis in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting them to pressure the White House to hit the brakes.

Analysts say Trump’s “maximum pressure plus last‑minute retreat” negotiating style might work in commercial games, but against an Iranian regime with a higher pain threshold it highlights the political cost of U.S. military options: a looming midterm election, oil‑price sensitivity, and dwindling ammunition stockpiles. Iran, meanwhile, is turning the perception that "the U.S. won’t dare to strike" into a psychological advantage, raising its demands simultaneously in nuclear talks, Strait navigation and proxy‑war fronts.

Market observers and diplomats interpret that if deterrence credibility continues to erode, the next risk is not how big a U.S. strike could be, but how aggressively Iran might act first—ranging from drone harassment to targeted attacks on energy facilities—making the regional powder keg even more volatile.

items.title: 日本本輪救匯狂砸11兆日元 接近歷史最大規模
items.title_en: Japan's Intervention Brings 11 Trillion Yen to Market, Approaching Historic Scale
paras: 本周一（3 日）晚間的消息顯示，根據日本央行的貨幣市場數據推算，上周四、周五的外匯干預中可能又動用了超過等值 11 兆日元的銀彈。
作為背景，日本在 4 月至 5 月期間的那一輪外匯干預中，共動用價值近 11.73 兆日元（約 736 億美元）的資金，創日本干預外匯市場單月規模新高。
日本央行的最新數據顯示，基於上周五政府部門的交易，金融體系將於周二面臨 11.4 兆日元的流動性流出。金融交易通常在兩個工作日後結算。貨幣經紀商此前預期的流出規模約 6 兆日元，多出來的 5 兆很有可能就是日本當局干預匯市的規模。
此前測算顯示，日本當局在上周四可能動用美元購入 6 至 7 兆日元。這意味著這一輪外匯干預很有可能接近甚至超越三個月前的紀錄。
日本財務大臣片山皋月周一早些時候發布聲明，證實日本和美國在上周五聯合干預匯市，以應對日元近期「過度波動和無序走勢」。她表示，將毫不猶豫採取進一步行動。
美國財長貝森特也在社交媒體發帖證實了這一行動，並表示「美國將毫不猶豫參與進一步聯合干預」。
作為本次干預的短線效果，日元匯率從上周四最低時的 1 美元兌 164 日元，到周一早盤時段曾觸及 1 美元兌 155.2 日元。
值得一提的是，在 4 月至 5 月的干預中，日元匯率也一度從 160 快速升至 155 區間。但由於日本貨幣的結構性弱勢（日美利差、油價上漲和美國聯準會升息預期），那一輪砸下 700 多億美元的效果僅維持了一個多月。
考慮到這些打壓日元的因素依然存在，即便美國罕見出手聯合干預日元，日元漲勢能維持多久依然面臨較大不確定性。
paras_en: According to data from the Bank of Japan, the country's currency market intervention on Thursday and Friday may have used more than ¥11 trillion in foreign exchange reserves.

In the context of the previous intervention in April and May, Japan used approximately ¥11.73 trillion (around $736 billion) in funds, setting a new record for the largest monthly intervention in the country's history.

The Bank of Japan's latest data shows that, based on government transactions on Friday, the financial system will face a liquidity outflow of ¥11.4 trillion on Tuesday. Financial transactions are typically settled two business days later.
Currency brokers had previously estimated a liquidity outflow of around ¥6 trillion, with the additional ¥5 trillion likely to be the scale of Japan's intervention in the foreign exchange market.

Previous estimates suggested that Japan may have used ¥6 to ¥7 trillion to purchase US dollars on Thursday, indicating that this round of intervention may be approaching or even surpassing the record set three months ago.

Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki released a statement on Monday morning, confirming that Japan and the US had jointly intervened in the foreign exchange market on Friday to address the yen's recent 'excessive volatility and disorderly movement'.
He stated that Japan would take further action without hesitation.
US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen also confirmed the action on social media, stating that 'the US will participate in further joint intervention without hesitation'.
As a short-term effect of the intervention, the yen's exchange rate rose from a low of 164 yen per dollar on Thursday to a high of 155.2 yen per dollar on Monday morning.

It's worth noting that the yen's exchange rate also rose from 160 to 155 in the previous intervention in April and May, but the effect was short-lived due to Japan's structural currency weakness (yen-dollar interest rate differential, rising oil prices, and expectations of a US Federal Reserve rate hike).
That intervention, which used over $700 billion, only lasted for a month.
Considering that these factors are still in place, even with the rare joint intervention by the US, the sustainability of the yen's rally remains uncertain.

隨後紐約聯邦儲備銀行總裁威廉姆斯表示，仍樂觀認為通貨膨脹壓力正朝著逐步緩解的方向發展，認為目前利率處於適宜位置，並據美國商務部公布 6 月建築支出意外跌 0.1%，突顯抵押貸款利率上升對房屋建設構成壓力，但 S&P 全球 7 月製造業 PMI 終值升至 53.9，而且美國供應管理協會 (ISM) 調查 7 月製造業 PMI 飆升至 2022 年 5 月以來最高 55.6，突顯訂單強勁增長帶動工廠產能增加及中東衝突擾亂供應鏈及持續推高投入成本，推動美元兌日圓收復大部分失地。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於 157.50-70，支撐於 156.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

美國總統川普週一將與伊朗舉行會談，期望迅速達成協議，重啟荷姆茲海峽及解決圍繞伊朗核能力僵局，重燃達成和平協議希望，改善風險偏好，並猜測日本再出手干預外匯市場提振日圓，但昨日 RatingDog/S&P 全球聯合公布中國 7 月製造業 PMI 降至四個月低點 50.9，令澳幣和紐元承壓，而且英國金融時報報導，美國財政部上週五與日本的協調行動支撐日圓，並非賣出美元，而是賣歐元，拖累歐元兌美元受限於 1.1558 高點。

據 S&P 全球 7 月製造業 PMI 調查，法國意外萎縮達 49.8，德國則重回四年高點 52.2，歐元區亦上揚至 51.9，創 4 月以來最高，但德國 6 月實質零售銷售較前月減少 1.1% 超過預期，而且歐洲央行 (ECB) 發表一篇經濟公報文章稱，伊朗戰爭爆發後消費者信心大幅下滑，歐元區家庭消費明顯萎縮，若衝突再升級，消費者支出可能再受抑制，打壓歐元兌美元至 1.1499 低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於 1.1520-40，支撐於 1.1440-60。
◆GBP/USD

週一會計師事務所安永分析師警告稱，若荷姆茲海峽在明年年中前仍未恢復通航，英國經濟明年可能萎縮，而且招聘平台 Indeed 調查今年上半年英國招聘活動減少，面向應屆畢業生職位空缺降至 2020 年以來最低，打擊英鎊兌美元自 1.3506 高點走低。隨著 S&P 全球英國 7 月製造業 PMI 連續九個月擴張達 51.9，但增速為四個月最低，擴大英鎊兌美元跌幅至 1.3414 低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於 1.3430-50，支撐於 1.3340-60。

items.title: 日元急升近5%只是曇花一現？ 美日聯手救匯率仍難敵利差 市場看衰日元長線走勢
items.title_en: Yen's 5% Surge May Be Just a Fleeting Moment: Joint Intervention Fails to Overcome Interest Rate Gap
paras: 美國與日本近日聯手干預外匯市場，推動日元自 40 年低點大幅反彈，單週升值近 5%，但市場普遍認為，在美日利率差距依舊懸殊、日本央行尚未採取進一步緊縮政策下，此次規模空前的干預行動恐怕只能暫時穩定匯市，難以從根本扭轉日元長期弱勢。
根據先前報導，美國總統川普在內閣會議中證實，美方參與此次聯合干預行動，並形容此舉是「友誼的信號」。
日本財務省隨後正式確認，已與美國財政部共同進場干預匯市，使日元自上週觸及的 40 年低點、每美元兌 164 日元，回升至 156.8 日元，單週升值幅度接近 5%。市場估計，本次干預規模超過 500 億美元。
不過，市場對此次干預反應相對冷淡。儘管日元短線急升，但匯價僅回到今年 5 月附近水準，年初至今兌美元升幅幾乎歸零。相較之下，2024 年日本銀行單獨干預匯市時，曾成功將日元由 161 升至 141，累計升值約 12%，此次反彈力道明顯較弱。
多位外匯策略師及經濟學家指出，只要美日利差維持高檔，任何官方干預都只能延緩跌勢，而無法改變日元疲弱的基本面。
此次聯合干預也被視為美日歷來規模最大的協同行動之一。有媒體拍攝到美國財政部長 Scott Bessent 桌上的待辦事項，其中寫有「買入日元 50 至 100 億美元」。另據《金融時報》引述知情人士報導，紐約聯邦準備銀行此次透過出售歐元、買入日元的方式參與市場操作。
值得注意的是，日本過去進場干預時，多半透過出售持有、規模約 1.1 兆美元的美國公債籌措資金。然而，目前 30 年期美國公債殖利率接近 20 年高點，大規模出售美債可能進一步推升殖利率，因此也限制了日本的操作空間。
此次干預也帶來另一項市場效應，美元指數跌破 100，為今年 6 月以來首見。在正式干預之前，Scott Bessent 與日本財務大臣片山皋月皆曾透過公開喊話試圖提振日元，但效果有限，最終促使雙方採取實際市場干預。
市場人士普遍認為，真正左右日元走勢的仍是利率差距，而非短期官方進場買盤。
Robin Brooks 表示，日元疲弱並非源於投機資金刻意做空，而是日本公債殖利率遠低於合理水準。他指出，資金自然流向報酬率較高的市場，才是日元持續承壓的根本原因。
目前日本政策利率僅 1%，而美國聯邦準備理事會聯邦基金利率目標區間則維持在 3.50% 至 3.75%，兩國利率仍存在明顯差距。
日本銀行上週召開政策會議後，決定維持利率不變，進一步強化市場對利差短期難以縮小的預期。
荷蘭國際集團經濟學家 Chris Turner 指出，日本央行若能在 9 月 18 日政策會議展現更明確的緊縮立場，仍有機會升息 1 碼 (25 個基點)。但他也強調，目前日本消費者物價指數 (CPI) 已接近 2%，政策利率卻只有約 1%，仍低於通膨水準，顯示日本貨幣政策依舊相對寬鬆。
Gavekal 執行長 Louis Gave 也持相同看法。他表示，除非聯準會開始降息，或日本銀行啟動升息循環，否則日元難以出現具持續性的升值走勢。他並認為，日元與其他東北亞貨幣一樣，目前均處於「嚴重低估」狀態，相關觀點也與德意志銀行 (DB-US) 7 月發布的《世界地圖》研究報告，以及《經濟學人》最新一期巨無霸指數分析相互呼應。
從基本面來看，日本擁有七國集團 (G7) 中最大的經常帳順差，理論上有利於支撐本國貨幣。不過，過去 15 年間盛行的日元套利交易 (carry trade)，即投資人借入低利率日元，再投資高收益資產，持續削弱日元需求，使基本面優勢未能有效反映在匯率表現上。
分析人士認為，只要日本銀行未能在貨幣政策上採取更積極行動，美日此次聯手干預的效果恐將隨時間逐漸消退，在利差與套利交易持續存在的情況下，日元結構性的弱勢格局短期內仍難出現根本性改變。
paras_en: The US and Japan have recently joined forces to intervene in the foreign exchange market, driving the yen to a significant rebound from its 40-year low, with a weekly gain of nearly 5%. However, the market is generally skeptical that this unprecedented intervention will be able to fundamentally reverse the yen's long-term weakness.
According to previous reports, US President Trump confirmed that the US participated in the joint intervention, describing it as a 'signal of friendship'.

The Japanese Ministry of Finance has since officially confirmed that it has joined forces with the US Department of the Treasury to intervene in the market, causing the yen to rise from its 40-year low of 164 yen per dollar to 156.8 yen, with a weekly gain of nearly 5%. The market estimates that the intervention scale exceeded $500 billion.

However, the market's response to this intervention has been relatively lukewarm. Although the yen has surged in the short term, the exchange rate has only returned to the level of May this year, and the year-to-date appreciation against the dollar has almost returned to zero. In comparison, the Japanese central bank's single-handed intervention in 2024 successfully raised the yen from 161 to 141, with a cumulative appreciation of around 12%, this time the rebound is significantly weaker.

Several foreign exchange strategists and economists point out that as long as the US-Japan interest rate gap remains high, any official intervention will only delay the decline, but will not change the yen's fundamental weakness.

This joint intervention is also seen as one of the largest cooperative actions between the US and Japan in history. Media outlets have captured a to-do list on US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's desk, which includes 'buying 50-100 billion yen'. According to a report by the Financial Times, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York participated in the market operation by selling euros and buying yen.

It's worth noting that Japan has previously intervened in the market by selling its holdings of US Treasury bonds, worth around $1.1 trillion. However, with the 30-year US Treasury bond yield approaching its 20-year high, large-scale sales of US bonds could further push up yields, limiting Japan's operational space.

This intervention has also brought another market effect, with the US dollar index falling below 100, a first since June this year. Before the formal intervention, Scott Bessent and Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Nagata had both used public statements to try to boost the yen, but with limited effect, ultimately prompting the two sides to take actual market intervention.
Market participants generally believe that the true driver of the yen's trend is still the interest rate gap, rather than the short-term official buying pool.

Robin Brooks notes that the yen's weakness is not due to speculative funds deliberately shorting the currency, but rather that Japan's bond yields are far lower than their reasonable level. He points out that funds naturally flow to markets with higher returns, which is the fundamental reason why the yen continues to be under pressure.

Currently, Japan's policy interest rate is only 1%, while the Federal Reserve's target range for the federal funds rate is 3.50-3.75%, with a significant gap between the two countries' interest rates.
The Bank of Japan last week held a policy meeting and decided to keep interest rates unchanged, further strengthening market expectations that the interest rate gap will not narrow in the short term.

Chris Turner, an economist at the Dutch International Group, notes that if the Bank of Japan can show a more clear tightening stance at the September 18 policy meeting, there is still a chance to raise interest rates by 1 point (25 basis points). However, he also emphasizes that Japan's consumer price index (CPI) is already near 2%, while the policy interest rate is only around 1%, still below the inflation level, indicating that Japan's monetary policy is still relatively loose.

Gavekal CEO Louis Gave also holds the same view. He notes that unless the Federal Reserve begins to lower interest rates or the Bank of Japan starts an interest rate hike cycle, the yen will find it difficult to show a sustained appreciation trend. He also believes that the yen, like other East Asian currencies, is currently in a 'severe undervaluation' state, which is consistent with the Deutsche Bank (DB-US) July report on the 'World Map' and the latest issue of the Economist's giant index analysis.

From a fundamental perspective, Japan has the largest current account surplus among the G7 countries, which should theoretically support its currency. However, the carry trade that has prevailed for the past 15 years, where investors borrow low-interest yen to invest in high-yielding assets, has continuously weakened yen demand, preventing the fundamental advantage from being effectively reflected in the exchange rate.

Analysts believe that as long as the Bank of Japan does not take more aggressive action in monetary policy, the effect of the US-Japan joint intervention will gradually fade over time, and in the presence of the interest rate gap and carry trade, the yen's structural weakness will remain difficult to change fundamentally in the short term.

items.title: USD/JPY：在日本與美國確認罕見的聯合干預後，日圓進一步反彈至155
items.title_en: USD/JPY: Yen Rallies Further to 155 After Rare Joint Intervention Confirmed by Japan and the U.S.
paras: 要點：

美元暴跌至 155.00 日圓
美國與日本聯手合作
波動性遊戲開始了？


這次美元兌日圓毫無招架之力。雙方都介入以協助掙扎中的日圓。

日圓獲得了一些支援


在日本和美國確認週五聯合買入日圓後，usdjpy 在週一跌至 155 附近。
該貨幣對週四曾高達 163.73，隨後在週五跌至 157.50。這真是一場政府贊助的情節大反轉。
這次行動是雙方自 2011 年以來的首次協調貨幣干預，也是自 1998 年以來首次透過直接購買來強化日圓的聯合行動。華盛頓通常讓東京自行捍衛其貨幣。
美國財政部長 Scott Bessent 表示，週五的協調行動反擊了「無序的日圓波動」。日本財務省也使用了類似的措辭，維持官方立場，即干預是針對過度波動，而不是特定的匯率。


紐約聯準會加入貨幣群聊


紐約聯邦準備銀行代表財政部採取行動，透過高盛和摩根士丹利賣出歐元並買入日圓。
歐洲央行官員也獲悉了這筆交易，這項不尋常的操作反映了華盛頓多麼重視該貨幣的無序下滑。
日本的干預過程通常從「匯率檢查」開始，日本央行會向交易員詢問目前的美元 / 日圓價格和交易規模。
這聽起來像是行政程序，但大致可以解讀為：官員們看到了這個水位，不喜歡它，並希望大家表現得識相點。
如果警告無效，日本財務省就會指示日本央行進入市場買入日圓，通常是透過賣出美元。週五的行動增加了美國的火力。隨著兩國政府購買同一種貨幣，押注日圓貶值的交易員突然面臨著財力異常雄厚的對手。


東京準備了更多彈藥


財務大臣 Satsuki Katayama 表示，日本將毫不猶豫地進行進一步的協調干預，並與美國財政部保持密切聯繫。
這將 160 至 164 日圓的區間從常規的圖表區域，變成了一個日圓空頭可能需要小心行事的地方。
干預措施已將美元 / 日圓匯率拉低至比週四高點低近 9 日圓的水準，但持久的成功仍取決於基本面。
日本的利率仍遠低於美國，干預很少能永久改寫這個等式。然而，它可以讓與之對抗的成本變得極其高昂。

paras_en:
Key points:

- The dollar plunged to ¥155.00
- U.S. and Japan coordinated action
- Is a volatility game starting?

The dollar‑yen pair was left defenseless this time. Both sides stepped in to aid a struggling yen.

The yen got some support.

After Japan and the United States confirmed a joint yen‑buying operation on Friday, USD/JPY fell to around 155 on Monday. The pair had peaked at 163.73 on Thursday before dropping to 157.50 on Friday. It was a government‑backed dramatic reversal.

This was the first coordinated currency intervention by the two countries since 2011 and the first joint direct‑purchase effort to bolster the yen since 1998. Washington usually lets Tokyo defend its own currency.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday’s coordinated action was a response to “disorderly yen volatility.” The Japanese Ministry of Finance used similar language, maintaining the official stance that the intervention targeted excessive volatility, not a specific exchange‑rate level.

New York Fed joins the currency chat.

A New York Federal Reserve Bank representative, acting on behalf of the Treasury, sold euros and bought yen through Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley.

European Central Bank officials were also informed of the trade, underscoring how seriously Washington views the yen’s disorderly decline.

Japan’s intervention process usually starts with a “rate check,” where the Bank of Japan asks dealers for the current USD/JPY price and trade size.

It sounds like a bureaucratic step, but essentially it means officials see the level, dislike it, and want market participants to behave.

If warnings fail, the Ministry of Finance instructs the BOJ to enter the market and buy yen, typically by selling dollars. Friday’s move added U.S. firepower. With both governments buying the same currency, traders betting on yen weakness suddenly faced a financially formidable opponent.

Tokyo is loading more ammunition.

Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said Japan will not hesitate to conduct further coordinated intervention and will stay in close contact with the U.S. Treasury.

This turns the ¥160‑¥164 band from a routine chart zone into an area where yen short sellers may need to tread carefully.

The intervention has pushed the USD/JPY rate down by nearly ¥9 from Thursday’s high, but lasting success still depends on fundamentals.

Japan’s rates remain far lower than U.S. rates, and intervention rarely rewrites that equation permanently. However, it can make the cost of opposing it extremely high.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 美日聯手干預日元與油價回落削弱通膨憂慮
items.title_en: New York FX: Dollar Flat as US‑Japan Joint Yen Intervention and Falling Oil Prices Ease Inflation Concerns
paras: 美元周一 (3 日) 變動不大，市場持續消化聯準會 (Fed) 最新的貨幣政策決議、美日兩國證實聯手干預日元匯市，以及地緣政治緊張局勢降溫帶動油價下跌、進一步緩解近期的通膨疑慮。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 持平於 99.90。
上周在聯準會宣布維持利率不變、並對未來貨幣政策路徑釋出不明朗訊號後，美元指數已下跌 1.5%。
受到美日兩國確認聯手干預日元匯市影響，美元兌日元承壓，下跌 0.3% 至 157.18，盤中一度跌至 155.23。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.2%，至 1 歐元兌 1.1508 美元。
市場同時關注油價走低，這有助於降低短期通膨壓力。這項趨勢也受到美國總統川普周末宣布的消息支持──美國將於今日與伊朗就荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz) 航運及去核化議題展開談判，顯示中東局勢明顯降溫。
美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 周日表示，美國堅定支持日本採取措施，糾正日元遭嚴重低估的情況，並明確警告，美國財政部將毫不猶豫參與未來任何進一步的聯合市場干預行動。
此次干預是數十年來美日首次聯手買進日元。在 7 月底日元兌美元一度跌破 162、創下 40 年新低後，兩國決定進場干預。
這次干預也為日元波動劇烈的 7 月畫下句點。最終日元 7 月兌美元升值 1.6%，創下去年 10 月以來最佳單月表現。市場干預，加上日本銀行 (BoJ) 釋出的鷹派訊號，引發大量空頭部位回補，推升日元走強。
市場也消化了日本銀行上周五公布的貨幣政策決議。日銀如市場預期，將基準利率維持在 1.0% 不變。
不過，日銀總裁植田和男 (Kazuo Ueda) 仍維持偏鷹立場。他警告，高能源進口成本可能推升通膨風險，並暗示央行仍準備在今年稍晚進一步升息。
整體外匯市場走勢，仍受到中東局勢發展影響。美國總統川普宣布，美國與伊朗官員將於周一恢復直接談判。
美國銀行全球研究部策略師指出，儘管市場因日本資金持續外流，以及高市早苗 (Sanae Takaichi) 政府政策風險等因素，對日元仍普遍抱持悲觀看法，但此次美日聯合干預具重大轉折意義。
美銀認為，美元兌日元 155 價位可能成為外匯市場的重要「轉折點」。策略師指出，今年稍早數次官方干預期間，美元兌日元都能在 155 附近獲得強力支撐，因此市場普遍認為官方干預效果有限。
然而，一旦匯價明確跌破 155，市場交易模式可能從「逢低買進美元」轉變為「反彈賣出美元」，企業避險需求所帶來的美元賣壓，也可能進一步加速此轉變。
美銀證券外匯與利率策略師 Shusuke Yamada 表示，「美國加入協同干預，提升市場對更廣泛政策架構的期待，目標是穩定日元匯率。」
他進一步補充，「由於美國參與，單方面耗盡外匯存底的限制實際上已經消除，因此投機資金要與官方對抗將變得更加困難。」
為降低出售美元可能對美國公債市場造成的影響，日本財務大臣與美國財長貝森特皆表示，將運用聯準會的「外國及國際貨幣當局附買回融資機制 (Foreign and International Monetary Authorities, FIMA)」提供流動性支援。
美銀也指出，此次聯合干預提高了市場對日銀加快升息步伐的預期，原本市場預估 10 月升息 1 碼，如今可能提前至 9 月實施。
另一方面，川普證實已取消原先規劃的軍事打擊行動，改以外交談判方式推動重新開放荷姆茲海峽，國際原油價格暴跌逾 4%，全球市場對能源推升通膨的短期憂慮也因此明顯降溫。
隨著地緣政治風險溢價略為消退，外匯市場接下來將把焦點轉向本周即將公布的一系列美國重要經濟數據，以研判聯準會 9 月的利率政策方向。其中最受關注的是一連串勞動市場數據，並將以 7 月非農就業報告作為壓軸焦點。

paras_en: The U.S. dollar changed little on Monday (the 3rd) as markets continued to digest the Fed’s latest monetary‑policy decision, the confirmed joint intervention by the United States and Japan in the yen market, and the cooling of geopolitical tensions that pushed oil prices lower and further eased recent inflation worries.
In the late New York session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, held steady at 99.90.
After the Fed announced it would keep rates unchanged last week and offered an ambiguous outlook for future policy, the dollar index had already fallen 1.5%.
Following the confirmation that the United States and Japan were coordinating a yen‑market intervention, the dollar fell 0.3% against the yen to 157.18, briefly dipping to 155.23 intraday.
The euro slipped 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1508 per euro.

Markets also focused on the decline in oil prices, which helps reduce short‑term inflation pressure. This trend was reinforced by a weekend announcement from U.S. President Trump that the United States would begin talks with Iran on Strait of Hormuz shipping and denuclearisation, signalling a clear de‑escalation in the Middle East.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday that the United States firmly supports Japan’s measures to correct the yen’s severe undervaluation and warned that the Treasury would not hesitate to join any further joint market‑intervention actions.

The intervention marks the first U.S.–Japan coordinated yen‑buying operation in decades. After the yen fell below 162 per dollar at the end of July – a 40‑year low – the two countries decided to step in.

The move also capped the volatile July for the yen. By the end of the month the yen had appreciated 1.6% against the dollar, its best monthly performance since October last year. Market intervention, together with hawkish signals from the Bank of Japan (BoJ), triggered a large short‑covering rally that pushed the yen higher.
Markets also absorbed the BoJ’s policy decision released last Friday. As expected, the central bank left its benchmark rate unchanged at 1.0%.

However, BoJ Governor Kazuo Ueda maintained a slightly hawkish stance, warning that high energy import costs could raise inflation risks and hinting that the bank remains ready to raise rates later this year.
Overall FX market direction continues to be shaped by developments in the Middle East. President Trump announced that U.S. and Iranian officials will resume direct talks on Monday.

Strategists at Bank of America Global Research noted that despite prevailing bearish sentiment on the yen – driven by continued outflows of Japanese capital and policy‑risk concerns under the Takaichi administration – the U.S.–Japan joint intervention is a significant turning point.

BofA believes the 155‑yen level could become a key “pivot point” in the FX market. The strategists point out that during earlier official interventions this year, the dollar/yen pair found strong support near 155, leading many to conclude that official actions have limited impact.

Nevertheless, if the exchange rate clearly breaks below 155, trading patterns may shift from “buy the dip in dollars” to “sell dollars on a rebound,” and corporate hedging‑driven dollar‑selling pressure could accelerate that shift.

Shusuke Yamada, BofA Securities FX and rates strategist, said, “U.S. participation in the coordinated intervention raises market expectations for a broader policy framework aimed at stabilising the yen.”

He added, “Because the United States is involved, the limitation of depleting foreign‑exchange reserves unilaterally is effectively removed, making it harder for speculative funds to oppose official actions.”

To mitigate any impact of dollar sales on the U.S. Treasury market, both Japan’s finance minister and Treasury Secretary Bessent said they would use the Fed’s Foreign and International Monetary Authorities (FIMA) repo facility to provide liquidity support.

BofA also noted that the joint intervention has heightened expectations that the BoJ will accelerate its rate‑hiking pace, moving a market‑expected 100‑basis‑point hike from October to possibly September.

Meanwhile, Trump confirmed that a previously planned military strike has been cancelled in favour of diplomatic negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, sending international crude prices down more than 4% and sharply cooling short‑term concerns that energy prices will drive inflation.

With the geopolitical‑risk premium easing slightly, the FX market will now turn its focus to a series of key U.S. economic releases due later this week, which will help gauge the Fed’s September rate‑policy direction. The most closely watched data are the upcoming labour‑market figures, with the July non‑farm payroll report serving as the headline release.

items.title: 日元反彈外溢亞幣！花旗、巴克萊齊發聲：韓元、新元與泰銖將受惠
items.title_en: Yen's Rebound to Benefit Asian Currencies, Says Citi and Barclays
paras: 美日聯合干預後日元急彈，亞洲貨幣跟漲行情獲華爾街點名，花旗與巴克莱最新客戶報告指出，因多數亞幣與日元走勢高度相關，「日元升值同樣會推動亞洲貨幣走強」，其中韓元、新加坡元、泰銖被列為最直接受惠者。
過去三個交易日裡，日元兌美元累計漲超 4%，脫離近 40 年低點，同期韓元、泰銖、菲律賓披索均升值至少 0.7%，不含日元的一籃子亞洲貨幣上漲 0.5%。
花旗駐新加坡策略師 Garg 與 Goh 在報告中指出，過去一年韓元、新元、新台幣與日元相關性最高，印度盧比與印尼盾最低。
巴克莱駐新加坡的 Kotecha 團隊也表示，韓元兌日元敏感度居亞洲前列，美日干預具協調性，外溢效果將大於歷史β值推算，首爾當局同步拋美元，韓元已升值至 9 個月新高，Fed 主席華許偏鴿導致美元回檔，也放大支撐力道。
不過，花旗與巴克莱均未把這視為趨勢反轉。根本錨點仍是美日利差。美國聯邦基金利率 3.5%–3.75%，日本僅 1%，差距 250–275 基點。
富蘭克林鄧普頓策略師提醒，干預只買時間、難替日本承擔政策代價；布魯金斯學者更直言，只要日債殖利率被人為壓住，日元仍被高估需下行。
中東能源風險、老齡化與產業空心化未解，加上美國這次賣歐元買日元，而非賣美元，讓市場對「聯手干預」成色存疑。
短線來看，日元帶動的亞洲貨幣修復可期；中長線匯率方向仍握在美日央行利差與套利交易手裡。
paras_en: Following the US-Japan joint intervention, the yen has rebounded sharply, and the trend of Asian currencies rising in tandem has been highlighted by Wall Street. According to the latest client reports from Citi and Barclays, since many Asian currencies are highly correlated with the yen, the appreciation of the yen will also drive the strengthening of Asian currencies. The Korean won, Singapore dollar, and Thai baht are expected to be the most direct beneficiaries.

Over the past three trading days, the yen has appreciated by more than 4% against the US dollar, moving away from its nearly 40-year low. During the same period, the Korean won, Thai baht, and Philippine peso have all risen by at least 0.7%, while a basket of Asian currencies excluding the yen has increased by 0.5%.

Citi strategists Garg and Goh stated in their report that over the past year, the Korean won, Singapore dollar, and New Taiwan dollar have had the highest correlation with the yen, while the Indian rupee and Indonesian rupiah have had the lowest correlation.

Barclays' team led by Kotecha in Singapore also noted that the Korean won has the highest sensitivity to the yen among Asian currencies. The coordinated US-Japan intervention will have a greater impact than historical beta calculations, and the Korean government's simultaneous sale of US dollars has driven the won to a nine-month high. The dovish stance of Fed Chairman Powell has also led to a decline in the US dollar, further supporting the won.

However, both Citi and Barclays do not view this as a trend reversal. The fundamental anchor remains the US-Japan interest rate differential, with the US federal funds rate at 3.5%-3.75% and Japan's rate at 1%, resulting in a difference of 250-275 basis points.

Franklin Templeton strategist warned that intervention only buys time and cannot replace the policy costs borne by Japan. A Brookings scholar stated that as long as Japan's bond yields are artificially suppressed, the yen is still overvalued and needs to decline. The unresolved issues of Middle East energy risks, aging population, and industrial hollowing, combined with the US selling euros to buy yen instead of selling US dollars, have raised doubts about the effectiveness of the joint intervention.

In the short term, the yen-led recovery of Asian currencies is expected. However, the medium- to long-term direction of exchange rates remains in the hands of the US-Japan central bank interest rate differential and arbitrage trading.
